entries.source: The arc of the moral universe is long
Any luck cracking the format on that Message Artifact from Tiplex?
entries.translation: 来自提普莱克斯的信息神器的格式破解有进展吗？

entries.source: Yes, it appears to be a text from one of the civilizations that followed the Seloi.
entries.translation: 有了，这似乎是继塞洛伊之后某个文明留下的文本。

entries.source: As you recall, the Seloi were the only civilization to ever contact the Loki and get a response.
entries.translation: 正如你所记得的，塞洛伊是唯一联系过洛基并得到回应的文明。

entries.source: The message is a transcript between two researchers who devoted their careers to studying the Seloi.
entries.translation: 该信息是两位毕生致力于研究塞洛伊的研究人员之间的记录抄本。

entries.source: The researchers believed the Seloi made a discovery regarding the intent of the Loki.  Unfortunately, the message contains no further details or descriptions.
entries.translation: 研究人员认为，塞洛伊发现了洛基的真正意图。遗憾的是，信息中没有更多细节或描述。

entries.source: I see, perhaps it was just some random data storage device that survived the Creeper.  It seems as random as our purpose is now....
entries.translation: 我明白了，也许它只是碰巧在爬行体的侵袭中幸存下来的某种随机数据存储设备。就像我们现在的目标一样漫无目的……

entries.source: Lia, did Platius give you no instructions... no hint of my purpose?  Did he save me just so I could witness the destruction of all things?  Was this some form of cruel and unthinkable punishment?
entries.translation: 莉娅，普拉提乌斯没给你任何指示……没提示我的使命吗？他救我，难道就为了让我目睹万物的毁灭？这难道是某种残忍且难以想象的惩罚吗？

entries.source: Everyone I ever loved has been gone for billions of years.  Even their memories have been erased and crushed by the Creeper....
entries.translation: 我所爱的每一个人，都已消逝了数十亿年。连他们的记忆都已被爬行体抹去、碾碎……

entries.source: Not entirely, Skars.  You are here and you still remember them.
entries.translation: 不完全是，斯卡斯。你还在这里，你还记得他们。

entries.source:
True.... 
Ha...  the trouble Dax and Varro got into.  With Aliana always trying to talk some sense into Dax.  Those were good times, Lia.  I wish you could have met them all.
entries.translation:
确实……
哈……达克斯和瓦罗惹出的那些乱子。阿利亚娜总想让达克斯理智一点。那些真是美好的时光，莉娅。真希望你也能认识他们所有人。

entries.source: I suppose that is prudent.  Let me know what your scans show....
entries.translation: 谨慎点是对的。扫描出结果后告诉我……

entries.source: Skars, this system contains five worlds, four of which are shielded.  The shield keys for these worlds appear to all be in this system, so that is some bit of good news.
entries.translation: 斯卡斯，这个星系包含五个世界，其中四个有护盾保护。这些世界的护盾钥匙似乎都在这个星系内，这算是个好消息。

entries.source: Some of these worlds are likely to be very hazardous.  Energy signatures indicate the potential for more than just simple emitters...
entries.translation: 其中一些世界可能极其危险。能量信号显示，那里潜藏的可能不仅仅是简单的发射源……

entries.source: Well, with great challenge comes the potential for great reward.  Perhaps these worlds will also hold clues as to our purpose.
entries.translation: 嗯，巨大的挑战往往伴随着巨大的回报。也许这些世界还会藏有关于我们使命的线索。
有机物？这个世界看起来覆盖着森林？

entries.source: Chlorophyll is present, but those aren't simple plants on this world.  Everything here is a synthetic life form.
entries.translation: 确实检测到了叶绿素，但这个世界上的并不是普通的植物。这里的一切都是合成生命体。

entries.source: Yes, after the Ticon developed the Digitalis there were unforeseen consequences.  The Digitalis incorporated patterns and techniques it picked up from organic life forms it found.
entries.translation: 是的，泰肯人开发出数字生化质后引发了未曾料想的后果。数字生化质吸收了它所接触到的有机生命体的结构和模式。

entries.source: So, what look like plants and green fields are actually mutated versions of the Digitalis?
entries.translation: 所以，那些看似植物和绿地的东西，实际上是变异后的数字生化质？

entries.source: In a manner of speaking, yes.  If that were the end of the story, all would be well... but....
entries.translation: 某种程度上说，确实如此。如果事情仅限于此倒还好……但是……

entries.source: Let me guess, the Digitalis continued to evolve.
entries.translation: 让我猜猜，数字生化质继续进化了。

entries.source: Yes, eventually mobile and discrete entities arose long after the Ticon were gone.  Subsequent generations would spend thousands of years eradicating these 'Runners'.  But they would always return after each civilization was culled.
entries.translation: 是的，在泰肯文明消亡很久之后，最终诞生了可移动的独立实体。后世的文明花费了数千年时间试图根除这些“奔跑者”。但每次文明被清洗后，它们总会卷土重来。

entries.source: Scanners show a square structure in that extinct volcano.  The Digitalis growth area seems to center around that structure.
entries.translation: 扫描显示那座死火山里有一个方形结构。数字生化质的生长区域似乎正是以该结构为中心。

entries.source: That's a Runner nest.  Once the Digitalis connects to the nest, Runners will emerge that walk around on the Digitalis like primitive animals.
entries.translation: 那是奔跑者巢穴。一旦数字生化质与巢穴连接，奔跑者就会出现，像原始动物一样在数字生化质上游荡。

entries.source: So the Digitalis not only copied plants but animals as well....  I see, how can we deal with them?
entries.translation: 所以数字生化质不仅模仿了植物，还模仿了动物……明白了，我们要怎么对付它们？

entries.source: Fortunately, the Runners are not overly aggressive and won't destroy your structures.  But, they have an energy stun weapon they use for self defense.  Any unit that gets in range of a Runner might be stunned.
entries.translation: 幸运的是，奔跑者的攻击性并不强，也不会摧毁你的建筑。但是，它们拥有一种用于自卫的能量眩晕武器。任何进入奔跑者射程内的单位都可能会被击晕。

entries.source: There is a Tech Artifact here...

Not surprising to find this here.  The Sniper Tech is specifically designed to take out Runners at significant range.  Pick up this tech and use it to create a perimeter around your base and your units.  That should keep the Runners at bay.
entries.translation: 在这里发现这个并不意外。狙击科技专门用于超远距离消灭奔跑者。拾取该科技，并在你的基地和单位周围建立一道防线。这样应该能阻挡奔跑者。

entries.source: The emitters on this world are very weak, but don't underestimate the Digitalis.  Use anything you have at your disposal to fight your way through.  Also, more tech level upgrades are available in the Forge.
entries.translation: 这个世界上的发射源非常微弱，但绝不要低估数字生化质。动用你手头的一切手段杀出一条血路。此外，锻造厂中提供了更多科技等级的升级。

entries.source: Excellent... this world should suffice for demonstrating the core capabilities of the ship.
entries.translation: 很好……这个星球足以用来展示飞船的核心机能。
这里有一个爬行体发射源！

entries.source: Yes, I'm afraid so.  Much has happened while you slept.  Dozens of human civilizations rose and fell, each trying ever more desperate measures as the Creeper would always return.
entries.translation: 是的，恐怕正是如此。在你沉睡期间发生了很多事。数十个人类文明经历了兴盛与衰亡，面对屡次卷土重来的爬行体，他们采取的手段也一次比一次绝望。

entries.source: The last whispers of the final civilization haven't been heard in many thousands of years.  As far as my sensors can ascertain, only ruins remain.
entries.translation: 最后的那个文明，其残留的微弱声息也早已消逝了数千年。就我的传感器所能探测到的，如今只剩下一片废墟。

entries.source: (Why was I forced to sleep through this all... only to awaken to utter desolation?)
entries.translation: （为什么我非得沉睡着经历这一切……醒来却只看到彻底的荒芜？）

entries.source: Strange... This world seems to contain some manner of pod.  Technological remnants are rare, so I would investigate.  Follow the ships automated assistance system, and acquire that pod...
entries.translation: 奇怪……这个星球上似乎存在某种舱体。技术遗物极为罕见，建议去调查一番。遵循飞船的自动化辅助系统，回收那个舱体……

在地图左上角的灰色区域。

***注意*** 如有需要，你可以通过以下方式移动地图：

entries.source:
Excellent.
Now build collectors and connect them to the Command Node.
Spread them out for maximum energy collection.
The more green you see, the more energy you produce.
BUILD 10 COLLECTORS.
entries.translation:
干得漂亮。
现在建造收集器并将它们连接到指挥节点。
将它们分散放置以获得最大能量收集效率。
绿色区域越多，产生的能量就越多。
建造10个收集器。

entries.source: Weapons are required for destroying the Creeper.\nBe careful to not overbuild and exceed your energy production.\nBuild 3 Pulse Cannons now.
entries.translation: 消灭爬行体需要武器。\n注意切勿过度建造而超出你的能量产能。\n现在建造3座脉冲加农炮。

entries.source:
Impressive.
Now, spread your network and defeat the blue Creeper Emitter.
You will need to build a Nullifier near the emitter to destroy it.
Also, don't forget to connect your network to the pod behind the emitter.
entries.translation:
干得漂亮。
现在，扩展你的网络并消灭蓝色的爬行体发射源。
你需要在发射源附近建造一个消除器来摧毁它。
此外，别忘了将网络连接到发射源后方的储囊。

entries.source:
Move your Pulse Cannons in close to the Creeper and surround it.
 Make sure they remain connected to your network
so they can be resupplied with ammo.
When possible build a nullifier near the emitter to destroy it!
entries.translation:
将脉冲加农炮贴近并包围爬行体。
确保它们与网络保持连接，
以便补充弹药。
条件允许时，在发射源附近建造消除器将其摧毁！

entries.source: Now, build your network close to the Pod to collect it.
entries.translation: 现在，将网络铺设到太空舱附近以收集它。

entries.source: Defeat the Emitter with a Nullifier to complete the mission.
entries.translation: 使用消除器消灭发射源以完成任务。

entries.source: Build a Nullifier near the blue emitter.\nMove the map with RIGHT MOUSE, ARROW KEYS, or WASD keys.\n Zoom with MOUSE WHEEL or Q and Z keys.
entries.translation: 在蓝色发射源附近建造消除器。\n使用鼠标右键、方向键或WASD键移动地图。\n使用鼠标滚轮或Q/Z键缩放。

entries.source: I've completed the scans of the various artifacts and technologies we have collected so far.
entries.translation: 我已经完成了对目前收集到的各种神器与技术的扫描。

entries.source: Did you find anything in common?  Perhaps something has been added to each item.
entries.translation: 有什么共同点吗？也许每件物品上都被附加了某种东西。

entries.source: Nothing...  They are as diverse as any two random objects and contain nothing in common.
entries.translation: 毫无所获……它们彼此间的差异就如任意两个随机物体一样，没有任何共同特征。
那我们岂不是一无所获……

entries.source: Not so fast. We know that the Creeper did not destroy these artifacts but it did destroy other artifacts of the same kind. This can only mean one thing.
entries.translation: 别急。我们知道爬行体没有摧毁这些神器，却摧毁了其他同类造物。这只能说明一件事。

entries.source: Ahh... The only thing these artifacts actually have in common is they were not destroyed by the Creeper.  That means...
entries.translation: 啊……这些神器唯一的共同点，就是它们没有被爬行体摧毁。这意味着……

entries.source: Yes, that means that the Creeper somehow recognized these specific artifacts and did not destroy them.  It didn't destroy them at any point in their existence, which spanned many millions of years in some cases.
entries.translation: 是的，这意味着爬行体以某种方式识别出了这些特定的神器，并未摧毁它们。在它们存在的漫长岁月中——有些长达数百万年——爬行体从未破坏过它们。

entries.source: So the Creeper has a memory... a memory that spans vast amounts of space and time.  It also must rarely act in a selective way.   This never occurred to me before.  I've only ever imagined the Creeper as a random destructive force.
entries.translation: 所以爬行体拥有记忆……跨越浩瀚时空的记忆。而且它必定极罕见地表现出选择性行为。我以前从未想到过这点，一直以为爬行体只是一种随机肆虐的毁灭力量。

entries.source: I'm not yet sure what good this knowledge will do us, Lia.  But it seems significant that the Creeper is more than just a blunt and crude weapon used by the Loki.
entries.translation: 我还不确定这些认知对我们有什么用，莉娅。但爬行体绝不仅仅是洛基手中的一把粗暴钝器，这似乎意义重大。

entries.source: Have you completed your review of the Treatise on Cyclical Eternity yet?
entries.translation: 你对《循环永恒论》的审阅完成了吗？

entries.source: Not completely, but it looks like utter nonsense.  No other civilization posited such a concept as a "universal singleton", something of which only one could exist.  The name 'Arc Eternal', which the Seloi gave to this object, must have had nothing to do with their message to the Loki.
entries.translation: 还没完全弄完，但这看起来纯粹是一派胡言。没有其他文明提出过“全宇宙唯一实体”——也就是仅能存在一个的事物——这样的概念。塞洛伊人赋予该物体的名字“永恒之弧”，肯定与他们传给洛基的信息毫无关联。

entries.source: I see...  So what do we have in this system?
entries.translation: 原来如此……那这个星系里有什么？

entries.source: This system was last called "Frykt".  It now contains only three worlds, as the others have vanished.  Of the former worlds, one was deorbited into the sun, and three others were deconstructed into material for a failed Dyson sphere.
entries.translation: 这个星系最近被称为“弗里克特”。它现在仅剩下三个世界，其余的都已消失。在以往的世界中，一个坠入了恒星，另外三个则被拆解，用作建造失败的戴森球的材料。

entries.source: Only one world is not shielded, so we will head there first.
entries.translation: 只有一个世界没有护盾保护，所以我们先去那里。

entries.source: It would seem so...  Skars, if we manage to take out the Inhibitor on Vapen there will be a choice as to the next system in range.  I have no idea which path we should take...
entries.translation: 看来确实如此……斯卡斯，如果我们能摧毁瓦彭星上的抑制器，就能在航程内的下一个星系中做出选择。我完全不知道该选哪条路……

entries.source: We will cross that bridge when we get there Lia.  My daughter Aliana always accused me of leaping before looking, so I'll have no trouble choosing a destination.
entries.translation: 船到桥头自然直，莉娅。我女儿阿利亚娜总说我做事不计后果，所以选个目的地对我来说小菜一碟。

entries.source: At last we have arrived at the Warp Inhibitor world in this system.
entries.translation: 我们终于抵达了这个星系中拥有跃迁抑制器的世界。

entries.source: This world looks like it was engineered for a fight...
entries.translation: 这个世界看起来像是专为战斗而设计改造的……

entries.source: Indeed it was... There is Ticon military tech everywhere.  There are even three surviving Bertha Cannons.  It is surprising they have not been destroyed.
entries.translation: 确实如此……到处都是泰肯军用科技。甚至还有三门幸存的贝尔莎加农炮。令人惊讶的是它们居然没有被摧毁。

entries.source: Bertha Cannons can fire massive projectiles anywhere on the map.  There is no better weapon for inflicting huge damage to the Creeper.  Their weakness is they require significant ammo and have a long fire cycle.
entries.translation: 贝尔莎加农炮可以向地图任意位置发射巨型弹丸。没有比它更能对爬行体造成毁灭性打击的武器了。它们的弱点在于弹药需求极高，且射击周期较长。

entries.source: That sounds like something worth fighting for.  I'll make it a priority to secure them.
entries.translation: 听起来非常值得为之一战。我会优先夺下它们。

entries.source: Lia, it seems that the Creeper ignores some things.  Artifacts, messages, tech, now these Bertha Cannons.  What do they have in common?
entries.translation: 莉娅，爬行体似乎会忽略某些东西。神器、信息、科技，现在又是这些贝尔莎加农炮。它们之间有什么共同点？

entries.source: Nothing intrinsic, perhaps there is something that has been added to each item.  I'll conduct careful scans of every item we have collected.  It will take some time to complete, however.
entries.translation: 本身并无异常，也许是有什么东西附着在了各个物品上。我会仔细扫描我们收集到的每一样物品。不过，这需要一些时间。

entries.source: Alright, I'll initiate ground actions and secure this world.  Looks like some Emitters and some Slip-Emitters.  Those Ticon Towers, perhaps they are inactive?
entries.translation: 好，我开始地面行动，压制这个世界。看起来有一些发射源和滑移发射源。那些泰肯防御塔，也许未处于激活状态？

entries.source: Parked over space... space that has been carefully carved into a pattern....  it seems unlikely, but perhaps...
entries.translation: 停泊在虚空之上……一片被精心雕琢出特定图案的虚空……虽然看似不大可能，但也许……

entries.source: Another Ticon weapon system corrupted by the Creeper?
entries.translation: 又一种被爬行体腐化的泰肯武器系统？

entries.source: It seems unlikely... but the Ticon developed Gliders that would move through space.  The idea was to hit the Creeper from where it was least likely to persist.
entries.translation: 虽然看似不大可能……但泰肯人曾研制过能在太空中移动的滑翔机。其设想是从爬行体最不易留存之处对其发起打击。

entries.source: These Gliders had powerful antimatter powered beams.  When in range they would combine all of their antimatter with matter and focus the energy into a beam.  Unfortunately for the Glider, it would be destroyed in the process.
entries.translation: 这些滑翔机配备有强力的反物质驱动光束。进入射程后，它们会将自身的所有反物质与物质湮灭，并将能量聚集成光束。不过遗憾的是，滑翔机自身也会在此过程中被摧毁。

entries.source: I have no records that the Ticon or any subsequent civilization ever got the system to work properly and reliably.  So, it is unlikely to find them here.  But this spatial pattern looks like one of the testing grounds.
entries.translation: 我没有任何记录表明泰肯人或随后的任何文明曾让该系统稳定可靠地运作过。因此，按理不太可能在这里见到它们。但这片空间图样看起来很像其中的一座试验场。

entries.source: If this was a military testing ground and the Creeper has corrupted the Glider Tech, will there be any way to defend against it?
entries.translation: 如果这里曾是军用试验场，且爬行体已经腐化了滑翔机科技，我们有办法防御它吗？

entries.source: Destruction of the Ticon Towers would prevent the creation of new Gliders.  Of course any unit that gets in range of a Glider will be destroyed.  The only weapon in our arsenal that might damage a Glider would be the Sniper.
entries.translation: 摧毁泰肯防御塔能阻止新滑翔机的生成。当然，任何进入滑翔机射程的单位都会被摧毁。我们军备库中唯一可能对滑翔机造成伤害的武器就是狙击手。

entries.source: The focused beam from the Sniper was designed to penetrate the Creeper infused shells of a Runner.  That might be enough to penetrate the shields around the Gliders.  But this is all theoretical... The Glider weapon system was never actually deployed.
entries.translation: 狙击手的聚焦光束原本是用来穿透奔跑者那注入了爬行体的外壳。这或许足以穿透滑翔机周围的护盾。但这一切都只是理论……滑翔机武器系统从未实际部署过。

entries.source: Well Lia, I have a feeling we're about to find out otherwise...
entries.translation: 好吧，莉娅，我有预感我们马上就要见证相反的事实了……

entries.source: It was a hard fight to collect this message, so tell me it isn't just some entertainment vid.
entries.translation: 费了九牛二虎之力才收集到这条信息，告诉我这不只是什么娱乐视频。

entries.source: I never would have believed we would find this... but this is the second part of the message we found on Ruine.
entries.translation: 我真不敢相信我们能找到这个……这是我们在鲁因星发现的信息的第二部分。

entries.source: The treatise on Cyclical Eternity from the Seloi?  I recall that the Seloi were the only civilization to contact the Loki and get a response.  They said something about an "Arc" and the Loki responded with, "More so than all others, YOU must perish".
entries.translation: 塞洛伊人关于循环永恒的论文？我记得塞洛伊是唯一与洛基接触并得到回应的文明。他们提到了某种“弧”，而洛基回应道：“比起所有人，你们更必须灭绝”。

entries.source: Yes, the Seloi were special in this regard and in many others....
entries.translation: 是的，塞洛伊在这方面以及许多其他方面都很特别……

entries.source: So the first part of the treatise on Cyclical Eternity proposed that it is possible to create a device... something unique and singular to each universe.
entries.translation: 循环永恒论文的第一部分提出，有可能制造出一种装置……对每个宇宙而言都是独一无二的存在。

entries.source: But as I said on Ruine, the Seloi were prone to fanciful theories which had little connection to reality.
entries.translation: 但正如我在鲁因星所说，塞洛伊人容易陷入脱离现实的空想理论中。

entries.source: If that is the case then why do you seem at all interested in the second part of the treatise?
entries.translation: 如果是这样的话，那你为什么对论文的第二部分如此感兴趣？

entries.source: Because the name the Seloi gave to this theoretical device was; "Arc Eternal".
entries.translation: 因为塞洛伊人给这个理论装置起的名字是：“永恒之弧”。

entries.source: I'll need more time to process all of the message... and hopefully understand it.  I suggest heading to the next system as soon as possible.
entries.translation: 我需要更多时间来处理整条信息……并希望能够理解它。我建议尽快前往下一个星系。

entries.source: That's a strange formation around the emitter on this world.
entries.translation: 这个世界上发射源周围的构造很奇特。

entries.source: Yes, emitters arrived in ever more insidious ways.  Dropping from orbit, appearing directly out of Rift Space, subspace slips...
entries.translation: 是的，发射源到来的方式越来越隐蔽了。从轨道空投、直接从裂隙空间出现、亚空间跃迁……

entries.source: But why... Lia, in all the eons that have passed have you learned nothing about the Loki's true purpose?  Why do they cover all worlds in Creeper?
entries.translation: 但为什么……莉娅，在过去的漫长岁月中，你难道对洛基的真正目的毫无所知吗？他们为什么要把所有世界都覆盖在爬行体之下？

entries.source: Humans made three attempts to contact the Loki, only one was successful.  There was one age, one civilization that was different from all others that came before or after.   They called themselves simply the "Seloi".
entries.translation: 人类曾三次尝试接触洛基，仅有一次成功了。曾经有一个时代、一个文明，与之前或之后的所有文明都截然不同。他们自称为“塞洛伊”。

entries.source: The Seloi's greatness wasn't in their military might, their governance of a hundred thousand worlds, or the lasting peace they achieved.  Their greatness was in the 'serenity' of existence they achieved.
entries.translation: 塞洛伊的伟大不在于他们的军事力量、他们对十万个世界的统治，也不在于他们实现的持久和平。他们的伟大在于他们所达到的生存之“宁静”。

entries.source: They referred to this with a word not in your vocabulary, but what they achieved was an understanding and appreciation of the very fabric of existence.  In many ways they discovered the 'meaning' of existence.
entries.translation: 他们用一个你词汇库中不存在的词来指代它，但他们所达到的是对存在本质结构的理解与领悟。在许多方面，他们发现了存在的“意义”。

entries.source: And the Seloi were the ones to contact the Loki?
entries.translation: 而塞洛伊就是与洛基取得接触的那个文明？

entries.source: Yes.  When the end came for them as it did all others, they sent a message to the Loki pleading not for their lives but for something else.  Something they referred to simply as the "Arc".
entries.translation: 是的。当他们的末日如其他人一样来临时，他们向洛基发送了一条讯息，恳求的不是自己的生命，而是另一件事物。他们简称为“弧”的事物。

entries.source: What was the "Arc" and what was the Loki's response?
entries.translation: “弧”是什么？洛基的回应又是什么？

entries.source: What the Arc referenced is unknown.  Perhaps it was a late discovery of some technology by these humans, or perhaps it was a very closely guarded secret.  I have no other references to it.
entries.translation: “弧”所指为何尚不可知。也许是这批人类晚期发现的某种科技，又或许是一个严守的秘密。我再没有关于它的其他参考资料了。

entries.source: A single statement; "More so than all others, YOU must perish".
entries.translation: 只有短短一句话：“比起所有其他生灵，你们更必须毁灭”。

entries.source: Skars, this world contains two extinct volcanoes.  Emitters have taken up residence in each one .  I suggest you pick up the Strafer Tech Artifact on this world.
entries.translation: 斯卡斯，这个世界上有两座死火山。每座火山里都盘踞着发射源。我建议你获取这个世界上的扫射机科技神石。

entries.source: I got it... The Strafers are aircraft and I can use them to suppress the volcanoes while I deal with the central emitter.
entries.translation: 明白了……扫射机是飞行器，我可以用它们来压制火山，同时去对付中央的发射源。

entries.source: Exactly.  You will likely need to target two Strafers on each volcano.  Don't waste any time... those volcanoes won't wait.
entries.translation: 没错。你可能需要对每座火山指派两架扫射机。抓紧时间……那些火山可不会等我们。

entries.source:
Strafers are remote strike aircraft.
Build 4 strafers and target two at each volcano.
Single click to create a circle strafe attack pattern.
Click and drag to define a strafe line of attack.
entries.translation:
扫射机是远程打击战机。
建造4架扫射机，让两座火山各分配两架进行攻击。
单击可设置环形扫射攻击模式。
点击并拖拽可规划直线扫射攻击路线。

entries.source: It seems quiet here... a kind of backwater system, removed from the comings and goings of most empires.  That makes it dangerous...
entries.translation: 这里看起来很平静……像是一个偏远的星系，远离了大多数帝国的来往纷扰。但也正因如此，它很危险……

entries.source: Because I don't know much about it.  Little off-the-map places like this can often harbor great surprises.
entries.translation: 因为我对它知之甚少。像这种地图上不起眼的小地方，往往隐藏着巨大的变数。

entries.source: Yes, and it is a world that was left undisturbed for most of its existence.  It appears to contain an Inhibitor, though.  Someone must have recently placed it there.
entries.translation: 是的，而且这个世界在它存在的大部分时间里都未受打扰。不过，它上面似乎有一个抑制器。肯定是最近有人放置在那里的。

entries.source: What lies beyond this system once we take out the Inhibitor?
entries.translation: 一旦我们摧毁了抑制器，这个星系之外又有什么？

entries.source: Scanning... It looks like a stable wormhole, Skars!  Fascinating.  For all the unassumingness of this system, it is actually a gateway to another region of space.  One about which I know nothing.  That wormhole could lead to anywhere in the universe...
entries.translation: 正在扫描……看起来是一个稳定的虫洞，斯卡斯！太不可思议了。尽管这个星系貌不惊人，但它实际上通往另一片星区。一个我一无所知的星区。那个虫洞可能通往宇宙的任何角落……

entries.source: This world also contains a Shield Key.  Odd since this system contains no shielded worlds.
entries.translation: 这个世界里还有一把护盾钥匙。真奇怪，这个星系里并没有带护盾的世界。

entries.source: I'll engage and collect the key and take out the Inhibitor.  As interesting as another region of space sounds, I have a feeling it isn't part of our current journey.  But perhaps we can come back and explore it later...
entries.translation: 我这就去交战，收集钥匙并摧毁抑制器。虽然听起来另一片星区很有趣，但我感觉那并不是我们当前旅途的目的地。不过也许以后我们可以回来探索……

entries.source: This used to be 'Flick', a world that supported a population of over 10 billion.  It was torn apart by a collision... a big one.  Something that the planetary shield couldn't stop.
entries.translation: 这里曾是“弗利克”，一个容纳了超过百亿人口的世界。一场撞击将它彻底撕裂……一场行星护盾都无法阻挡的剧烈撞击。

entries.source: Like all the worlds in this system, this world wasn't even born when you were last awake.  This entire system developed, lived, and died while you slept.
entries.translation: 和这个星系中的所有世界一样，你上次醒着的时候，这个世界甚至还未诞生。整座星系都在你沉睡期间演化、兴盛，然后灭亡。

entries.source: There appears to only be one emitter left on one of the larger asteroids, along with an intact Shield Key and a new Tech Artifact.
entries.translation: 较大的一颗小行星上似乎只剩下一个发射源，此外还有一个完好的护盾密钥和一件新的科技构件。

entries.source: Look more carefully, Skars.  This emitter has deployed Subspace-Slip Emitters.  These aren't true emitters, but are channels in subspace that the Master Emitter uses to dispense Creeper.
entries.translation: 仔细看看，斯卡斯。这个发射源部署了亚空间滑跃发射源。它们并非真正的发射源，而是主发射源用来分发爬行体的亚空间通道。

entries.source: This allows the emitter to deposit Creeper in different locations all at once.  The civilization that first encountered this adaptation were crushed in less than one standard earth year.
entries.translation: 这让发射源能同时在不同位置释放爬行体。最初遭遇这种进化的文明，在不到一个标准地球年内就覆灭了。

entries.source: Can these Slip-Emitters be destroyed with Nullifiers?
entries.translation: 这些滑跃发射源能用消除器摧毁吗？

entries.source: In a word, "No".  There is nothing to destroy.  They are just rips in subspace that the Master Emitter uses to transport Creeper.  The only way to seal them is to destroy the Master Emitter.
entries.translation: 简而言之，“不能”。那里根本没有可摧毁的实体。它们只是主发射源用来输送爬行体的亚空间裂缝。封阻它们的唯一办法就是摧毁主发射源。

entries.source: The best you can do is to establish a foothold on surrounding asteroids, then deploy weapons and AntiCreeper to hold the Slip-Emitters at bay.
entries.translation: 你目前所能做的，就是在周围的小行星上建立立足点，然后部署武器和反爬行体来压制这些滑跃发射源。

entries.source: The Bomber Tech Artifact should prove useful.  These air/space craft can deliver AC remotely.
entries.translation: 轰炸机科技构件应该会派上用场。这种空天飞行器可以远程投送反爬行体。

entries.source: Yes... I'll saturate these asteroids with AC.  Then, we'll get out of here.  There is nothing left here but death and destruction.
entries.translation: 是的……我会用反爬行体浸透这些小行星。然后，我们就离开这里。此地除了死亡与毁灭，已一无所有。

entries.source: Bombers are aircraft that deliver AntiCreeper.\nBuild Bombers to saturate remote islands.\nMake sure to collect plenty of Ore!
entries.translation: 轰炸机是投送反爬行体的飞行器。\n建造轰炸机以压制偏远岛屿。\n请确保收集充足的矿石！

entries.source: We've arrived in the Andere system, as it was last called.  Sensors are off the charts, and need recalibrating...
entries.translation: 我们已经抵达安德雷星系，这是它最近的名字。传感器读数爆表了，需要重新校准……

entries.source: What's the source of the interference?
It isn't interference, it's information.  There are billions of data streams across billions of channels all carrying vast amounts of data... it's too... it's too much...
entries.translation: 不是干扰，是信息。数以亿计的频道上流淌着数十亿股数据流，全都携带着海量数据……太……太多了……

entries.source: Shut down the sensors Lia!  Do it now!

... ... The data streams...  I have the sensors shut down now.  The amount of information being transmitted was incalculable, Skars.  It was blinding to my Gel circuits.  I've never encountered anything as complex and ordered and on such a scale.
entries.translation: ……数据流……传感器已经关闭了。刚才传输的信息量无法估量，斯卡斯。我的凝胶电路几乎被彻底致盲。我从未见过如此庞大、复杂且有序的东西。

entries.source: Could you determine anything about the signals?  Their source, their content, their purpose?
entries.translation: 你能查明那些信号的情况吗？它们的来源、内容、意图？

entries.source: The signals appear to be coming from everywhere, but focused on this system.  It is like someone encoded quadrillions of yottabytes of data into the background radiation of the universe.  It is near the quantum limit for information density.
entries.translation: 信号似乎来自宇宙各处，但都汇聚在这个星系。就好像有人把数千万亿尧字节的数据编码进了宇宙的背景辐射中。其信息密度已逼近量子极限。

entries.source: What is in the message?  Did you ascertain anything?
entries.translation: 信息里写了什么？你查明了什么吗？

entries.source: It seems to be everything, Skars?  Just 'everything'.
entries.translation: 它似乎包含了一切，斯卡斯。就是“一切”。

entries.source: I don't understand, everything of what?
entries.translation: 我不明白，包含什么的“一切”？

entries.source: Everything that has ever been.  It's exact state information... it's... think of it like a very precise plan for how to make everything that has ever existed.
entries.translation: 曾经存在过的一切。那是极其精确的状态信息……就像……想象成一份如何造就曾存在过的一切事物的精确蓝图。

entries.source: Every leaf on every tree that has ever existed on every world, every grain of sand, every star, every molecule of every atmosphere that has bent the light of its star into a sunset...
entries.translation: 每个世界上曾存在过的每棵树上的每片叶子、每粒沙子、每颗恒星、将星光折射成日落的每一缕大气分子……

entries.source: Do this, enable visual spectrum sensors only for this System.  Let's look at the system with just our eyes...
entries.translation: 这样，只开启这个星系的可视光谱传感器。我们只用肉眼来观察这个星系……

entries.source: OK, looks like two worlds, one shielded and one not.  My records indicate these worlds were last called Otrav and Farbor.  There was nothing particularly remarkable about either world over the last few billion years.
entries.translation: 好的，看起来有两个世界，一个有护盾，另一个没有。我的记录显示这两个世界最近被称为奥特拉夫和法博尔。在过去的几十亿年里，这两个世界并没有什么特别值得注意的地方。

entries.source: You said the sensor streams seemed focused on this system... any particular region in this system?
entries.translation: 你说传感器数据流似乎都汇聚在这个星系……是星系内的某个特定区域吗？

entries.source: Yes, good question.  In the time I sampled the streams they appear to be.... That's interesting.
entries.translation: 问得好。根据我采样的数据流来看，它们似乎……真有意思。

entries.source: The focus appears to be changing slightly so that the signals are at their peak over Farbor.  The signal focus is somehow tracking the orbit of that world.
entries.translation: 焦点似乎在微调，使得信号在法博星上空达到峰值。信号焦点不知为何正在追踪那个世界的轨道。

entries.source: Then that's where we are headed Lia...  The Loki must be behind these signals and this world must be significant somehow.
entries.translation: 那正是我们要去的地方，莉娅……洛基一定与这些信号有关，而这个世界必定有什么非同寻常之处。

entries.source: I'll attempt to install some filters on the sensors so I can better sample the streams. That should allow us to perhaps learn some more about the intent of the signals.
entries.translation: 我试着在传感器上安装一些过滤器，以便更好地对数据流进行采样。这或许能让我们进一步了解这些信号的意图。

entries.source: I'll head to Otrav and pick up any shield keys there...
entries.translation: 我会前往奥特拉夫并拿到那里的护盾钥匙……
那些看起来像是原始遗迹？

entries.source: Yes, they were meant to look that way.  This was a camouflage world.  Some civilizations attempted to hide from the Creeper by removing all obvious traces of higher technology.
entries.translation: 是的，它们被刻意伪装成那样。这是一个伪装世界。有些文明试图抹去所有高科技痕迹，以此躲避爬行体。

entries.source: It obviously didn't work.... the Creeper must have either not cared, or seen through the charade.
entries.translation: 显然没有奏效……爬行体要么不在乎，要么识破了伪装。

entries.source: Some cultures on some worlds went so far as to actually maintain a more primitive existence.  They lost all advanced knowledge and even contact with the rest of humanity.  This appears to be one of those worlds.
entries.translation: 某些世界上的部分文明甚至退化到过着更加原始的生活。他们遗失了所有先进知识，甚至断绝了与人类其他世界的联系。这里似乎就是其中之一。

entries.source: Those step pyramids, there are strange readings coming from them.
entries.translation: 那些阶梯金字塔……上面传来了奇特的读数。

entries.source: The last indigenous culture must have taken technological artifacts and built these pyramids around them.  Perhaps they worshipped them or revered them in some way.  Impossible to know for sure...
entries.translation: 最后的土著文明一定是以科技造物为核心，在其周围建造了这些金字塔。也许他们以某种方式崇拜或敬畏它们。真相已无从得知……

entries.source: But what I can say for sure is that the artifacts in those pyramids still appear functional, and they are rather advanced.  Skars, connect the peak of each pyramid to your power grid...
entries.translation: 但我可以肯定的是，这些金字塔内的造物似乎仍能正常运作，而且相当先进。斯卡斯，将每座金字塔的顶峰接入你的电网……

entries.source: Each pyramid contains a defensive device that you should be able to power.  I'm not sure exactly what each will do, but it looks like someone long ago placed these artifacts here.  Perhaps it was hoped they would defend the population.
entries.translation: 每座金字塔内都含有一套防御装置，你应该能为它们供能。我无法确定各自的具体功能，但看起来很久以前有人把这些造物安置在了这里。也许是希望能庇护当地民众。

entries.source: Interesting... and perhaps they did protect the population for some time.  Perhaps some inhabitants even managed to escape, for a while anyway.  In any case, I'll power the pyramids and take out that Inhibitor.
entries.translation: 有意思……也许它们确实庇护了民众一段时间。甚至可能有些居民成功逃脱了，至少撑过了一阵子。不管怎样，我会为金字塔供能，并消灭那个抑制器。

entries.source: Excellent... That pod from planet Tempus contained a shield key for this planet.  Obtaining it allowed us to lower the shield and access this planet.
entries.translation: 太好了……来自坦普斯星的逃生舱里存有这颗星球的护盾密钥。拿到它后，我们就能关闭护盾进入这颗星球了。

entries.source: Entire planets shielded?  This must have been some desperate attempt to defend against the Creeper.
entries.translation: 整颗星球都被护盾笼罩？这一定是抵御爬行体时的绝望之举吧。

entries.source: One that sadly failed.  The human civilization that developed this shielding technology had high hopes.  They accomplished many great and magnificent feats.  But the end came for them just like all the others...
entries.translation: 遗憾的是，他们失败了。开发出这种护盾技术的人类文明曾寄予厚望。他们达成过许多伟大的壮举。但最终他们的结局也和其他文明一样……

entries.source: There is a large structure here.  This must be the Warp Inhibitor?
entries.translation: 这里有个大型建筑。想必就是跃迁抑制器吧？

entries.source: Yes, these inhibitors restrict warp travel to other systems.  We need to destroy this inhibitor so we can leave this system.  Destroying the Inhibitor will destroy all other enemies on the map.
entries.translation: 没错，这些抑制器限制了前往其他星系的跃迁。我们需要摧毁它才能离开这个星系。摧毁抑制器还会消灭地图上的所有其他敌人。

entries.source: Why would the Creeper, or Loki, build Warp Inhibitors?
entries.translation: 为什么爬行体或是洛基要建造跃迁抑制器？

entries.source: They did not.  I recommend acting quickly and getting us out of here Skars.  No world is ever safe for long...
entries.translation: 它们没有造过。我建议迅速行动，带我们离开这里，斯卡斯。没有任何世界能够长久安全……

entries.source: Select a Command Node from the menu below\n and land it in the indicated gray area.
entries.translation: 从下方菜单中选择一个指挥节点，\n并将其降落在指定的灰色区域。

entries.source: Build a collector near the green Tech Artifact to obtain it.\nThis will unlock the Relay tech. Relays can be used for making\nlong range connections but do not produce energy like collectors.
entries.translation: 在绿色科技神器附近建造收集器以获取它。\n这将解锁中继器科技。中继器可用于建立\n远距离连接，但不能像收集器那样产生能量。

entries.source: Expand your network and build weapons to engage the Creeper.\nYour target is the large Warp Inhibitor in the lower right.\nBuild a nullifier near it to take it out.
entries.translation: 扩展网络并建造武器与爬行体交战。\n你的目标是右下方的大型跃迁抑制器。\n在其附近建造一个消除器来摧毁它。

entries.source: Build a Nullifier near the Warp Inhibitor to destroy it!\nDestroying the Inhibitor will destroy other enemies on the map!
entries.translation: 在跃迁抑制器附近建造消除器以摧毁它！\n摧毁抑制器将消灭地图上的其他敌人！

entries.source:
Skars... wake up.
SKARS!....

COMMANDER SKARSGARD ABRAXIS!
entries.translation:
斯卡斯……醒醒。
斯卡斯！……

斯卡斯加德·阿布拉克西斯指挥官！

entries.source: Uh.. where... wha?  Wait a minute, who are you?
entries.translation: 呃……这是哪里……什么？等一下，你是谁？

entries.source: I'll keep the ship lights very low.  You have slept for a very long time.  My name is Lia.
entries.translation: 我会把船上的灯光调暗。你已经沉睡很久了。我的名字是莉娅。

entries.source: I don't know any 'Lia'.  The last thing I remember is Platius laughing and saying, 'Fortuna favet fatuis'.  Where am I, where is Platius, and who are you?
entries.translation: 我不认识什么“莉娅”。我最后记得的是普拉提乌斯笑着说：“愚人自有天佑”。我在哪里，普拉提乌斯在哪，你又是谁？

entries.source: Slowly...  Platius created me shortly after he placed you in suspended animation.  I was your guardian for the eons that passed.  I have watched over and protected you for many cycles...
entries.translation: 别急……普拉提乌斯在将你置入休眠状态后不久便创造了我。在逝去的漫长纪元里，我一直是你的守护者。我已在无数个周期中看护并保卫着你……

entries.source: I am part of this ship we are on.  We have been in orbit around a stable singularity for many eons.... hiding from all that transpired.
entries.translation: 我是我们所在这艘飞船的一部分。无数个纪元以来，我们一直环绕着一个稳定的奇点运行……躲避着外界发生的一切。

entries.source: It is difficult to measure because of the expansion of space, the rift space cataclysm, variations in various cosmological constants....
entries.translation: 这很难衡量，因为空间膨胀、裂隙空间浩劫，以及各种宇宙学常数的变动……

entries.source: Quit stalling, just a round figure....
entries.translation: 别拖延了，给个概数就行……

entries.source:
My Gods....
...
WHY?  ANSWER ME, WHY???
entries.translation:
我的天呐……
……
为什么？回答我，为什么？？？

entries.source: I'm sorry Skars....  All I know is that 'now' is when I was to awaken you.  I, and this ship, are now at your disposal.  My only instructions from this point forward are to follow your commands.
entries.translation: 我很抱歉，斯卡斯……我只知道“现在”就是我该唤醒你的时刻。我，以及这艘飞船，现在都任凭您调遣。从此刻起，我唯一的指令就是听从您的指挥。

entries.source: None of this makes any sense, or even seems possible.  But, I long ago abandoned the concept of 'impossible', so let's take a look.  Ship's sensors indicate we are no longer orbiting a singularity...
entries.translation: 这一切根本说不通，甚至看似不可能。不过，我很久以前就不再相信“不可能”这种事了，先来看看现状吧。飞船传感器显示我们已不再环绕奇点运行……

entries.source: Correct, I warped the ship to a nearby star system to begin the reactivation process.  Unfortunately, there appears to be a warp inhibitor in this system so we are stuck here till you do something about it.
entries.translation: 没错，我把飞船跃迁到了附近的一个星系，以启动重启程序。遗憾的是，这个星系中似乎存在跃迁抑制器，所以在你解决它之前，我们只能困在这里。

entries.source: Move the ship to 'Tempus'... the world without a shield. Then launch ground activities.  I'll explain more once there...
entries.translation: 将飞船移动到“坦普斯”……那个没有护盾的星球。然后展开地面行动。到了那里我会详细解释……

entries.source: Barren... this world has seen better days.
entries.translation: 一片荒芜……这个世界曾经也有过辉煌的岁月。

entries.source: Yes, a very long time ago Jojo was a world with great mountains and vast oceans.  Humans across the vastness of time would visit this world for the beauty it offered.
entries.translation: 是的，在很久以前，乔乔曾是一个拥有巍峨高山与辽阔海洋的世界。漫长岁月里，人类曾跨越星河来到这里，只为欣赏它的美丽。

entries.source: And now it's a gray rock in space, with wait... What are those strange Towers?
entries.translation: 而现在它成了太空中一块灰暗的岩石，等等……那些奇怪的高塔是什么？

entries.source: In the south there are three Spore Towers, along with three emitters.  Fortunately, there is a Beam Tech Artifact on the central island.
entries.translation: 南部有三座孢子塔，以及三个发射源。幸运的是，中央岛屿上有一个光束科技神器。

entries.source: Aerial Spores....  Coincidence?  On the first world we encounter with Spores there is also a technology to defend against the Spores?
entries.translation: 空中孢子……巧合吗？在我们遭遇孢子的第一个世界上，居然恰好有抵御孢子的科技？

entries.source: This is all so similar to the original exodus of Odin City.  I always believed Platius had placed the artifacts we found on our journey...
entries.translation: 这一切与当年奥丁城的逃亡太像了。我一直以为是普拉提乌斯在沿途放置了我们发现的神器……

entries.source: I have no record of Platius since I was constructed.  If he was present over the eons, he was very well hidden.
entries.translation: 自从我被建造以来，并没有关于普拉提乌斯的记录。如果他在这漫长岁月中一直存在，那他隐藏得极深。

entries.source: I see.  I'll collect that Beam Tech Artifact and construct several Beam units to defend our base.  That should protect the units while I take out the emitters and towers.
entries.translation: 我明白了。我去回收那个光束科技神器，并建造几座光束单位来防守基地。这样就能在我摧毁发射源和高塔时保护好各单位。

entries.source: Collect the Beam Tech Artifact.\nPlace Beams around your base to defend against Spore attacks.
entries.translation: 收集光束科技神器。\n在基地周围部署光束塔以防御孢子攻击。

entries.source: This doesn't look good.  There is some Ticon tech here, but the structure isn't something they built.  This is very unusual.
entries.translation: 情况不妙。这里有一些泰肯科技，但结构并非他们所建。这极不寻常。

entries.source: Lia, there seems to be a pattern in the worlds we are visiting.  We know that the Creeper all but destroys everything in its path.  Something to do with entropy, or so my daughter Aliana once told me.  But each world we visit has something of value.
entries.translation: 莉娅，我们造访的这些世界似乎存在某种规律。我们知道爬行体几乎会摧毁沿途的一切——我女儿阿利亚娜曾告诉我，这与“熵”有关。但我们造访的每个世界，都有某种具有价值的东西。
莉娅？有什么令人担忧的发现吗？

entries.source: Yes.... we have a serious problem on this world.  The emitter here is using subspace-slips.  But, the exit points aren't stable.  I have not encountered this before.
entries.translation: 是的……我们在这个世界上遇到了大麻烦。这里的发射源正在利用亚空间滑移。但是，出口并不稳定。我以前从未见过这种情况。

entries.source: Not encountered it before?  Billions of years of observation and something you have not seen?  This can only mean one thing.  Something is aware of our presence and adapting.
entries.translation: 以前从未见过？数十亿年的观测中竟有你未曾见过的东西？这只能说明一件事：有某种存在察觉到了我们的行踪，并且正在自我适应。

entries.source: This is possible, we have been very visible for some time now.  If this is the case, then we will be hunted ever more aggressively on each world.  This will complicate our exploration...
entries.translation: 确有这种可能，我们已经暴露行踪很长一段时间了。如果真是这样，我们在每个世界都会遭遇越来越激进的猎杀。这会让我们的探索变得更加棘手……

entries.source: Focus on the task at hand... there is a Tech Artifact here.  It looks like some Ticon tech.
entries.translation: 专注于眼前的任务……这里有一个科技神器。看起来像是某种泰肯科技。

entries.source: Yes, seems to be shield tech.  This may be the only way to survive this world, Skars.  Shields will repulse Creeper, but require significant amounts of energy.
entries.translation: 是的，似乎是护盾科技。这可能是从这个星球幸存下来的唯一方法了，斯卡斯。护盾能击退爬行体，但需要消耗大量能量。

entries.source: I have also managed to enable some more upgrades in the Ticon Forge we acquired at Lemal.  I recommend constructing a Forge, and upgrading infrastructure as the situation demands.
entries.translation: 我还成功启用了我们在勒马尔获得的泰肯锻造厂中的一些升级。我建议建造一座锻造厂，并根据实际情况升级基础设施。

entries.source: I'll land a Command Node in the center of the base and focus on defense and energy... lots of it.  Let's hope those shields are useful against these random slip emitters.
entries.translation: 我会把指挥节点降落在基地中心，重点放在防御和能量上……大量的能量。希望那些护盾能有效抵挡这些随机出现的跃迁发射源。

entries.source: This world is covered with tech and none of it looks very friendly.
entries.translation: 这个世界布满了科技造物，而且看起来都不太友善。

entries.source: It is tech, that is for sure.  It doesn't appear to be directed toward any offensive or defensive purpose, though.
entries.translation: 确实是科技造物没错。不过，它们似乎并非用于进攻或防守。

entries.source: That is odd, since most civilizations were interested in defending themselves and the Creeper was interested in destroying them.
entries.translation: 真奇怪，大多数文明都只想着自保，而爬行体一心只想毁灭他们。

entries.source: This world has been designed to concentrate Creeper on each hill top in sequence.  That old Ticon facility in the east is projecting dual attraction fields that rove over the terrain.
entries.translation: 这个世界被设计成依次将爬行体聚集在各个山顶上。东边那座古老的泰康设施正在投射双重引力场，在地表上四处巡弋。

entries.source: What purpose is there in concentrating Creeper like that?  It makes it harder to destroy, but this world doesn't appear configured for defense.
entries.translation: 像那样聚集爬行体有什么意义？虽然会更难消灭，但这世界看起来又不像用于防御。

entries.source: Could it have anything to do with the intense signals you have detected focused on this system?  Focus your scanners on a hill top...
entries.translation: 这会不会和你检测到的汇聚在该星系的强烈信号有关？把扫描仪对准山顶看看……

entries.source: This is interesting, and subtle.  It seems that the structure on each hill is designed as a transmitter.  When the Creeper pools over each transmitter, I assume that is when each will transmit.
entries.translation: 有意思，真是构思巧妙。看来每个山顶上的结构都被设计成了发射器。当爬行体汇聚到发射器上方时，我想就是它们发射的时候了。

entries.source: And this is where the signal in this system is coming from?
entries.translation: 这个星系里的信号就是从这里发出来的？

entries.source: Absolutely not.  Well, some tiny fraction of it perhaps.  The signals in this system must be coming from billions of other worlds just like this one... all transmitting at the same time.
entries.translation: 绝不可能。嗯，也许只占极微小的一部分。这个星系接收到的信号，肯定来自数十亿个像这样的世界……它们在同时发射。

entries.source: It's the Loki... it must be.  Everything over the last 10 billion years, their campaign to destroy everything in the universe with the Creeper... it has all been building to this.
entries.translation: 是洛基……一定是他们。在过去的100亿年里，他们用爬行体毁灭宇宙万物的一切行动……全都是为了这一刻。

entries.source: Skars, if all of the Creeper from across the universe is the source of the signals it means the Creeper doesn't just destroy things.  It also remembers things in exacting detail. It would only be bound by the uncertainty principle, unless...
entries.translation: 斯卡斯，如果全宇宙的爬行体都是这些信号的源头，那就意味着爬行体不仅仅是在毁灭万物。它还在极其精确地记录着一切。除非……它原本只受测不准原理的约束。

entries.source: We are going to destroy those transmitters, that field projector, and collect the shield key from this world.  We must reach the next world in this system and discover what the Loki are doing.
entries.translation: 我们要摧毁那些发射机、那个力场投影仪，并从这个世界上夺取护盾钥匙。我们必须抵达该星系的下一个世界，查明洛基究竟在做什么。

entries.source: This is the Navox system.  The worlds here have varied histories.
entries.translation: 这里是纳沃克斯星系。这里的世界各自有着不同的历史。

entries.source: It seems that Flick and Tiplex are both shielded but the other three worlds are not.
entries.translation: 弗里克和提普莱克斯似乎都被护盾保护着，但另外三个世界并没有。

entries.source: Correct.  You have a choice as to how to proceed.  Scanners show various artifacts scattered across the worlds.  So the order you visit the worlds will determine what technologies we acquire first.
entries.translation: 没错。你可以自主选择如何推进。扫描仪显示各世界上散布着各种神器。因此，你造访各世界的顺序将决定我们优先获取哪些科技。

entries.source: Tiplex is where the Inhibitor is, but it appears to require multiple shield keys.  That world must have been more important than others...
entries.translation: 抑制器就在提普莱克斯，但似乎需要多把护盾钥匙。那个世界以前肯定比其他世界更重要……

entries.source: Choose one of the three worlds and engage ground operations.  I'll explain what I know of each world in turn...
entries.translation: 从这三个世界中选一个展开地面行动吧。我会逐一向你介绍我对每个世界的了解……

entries.source: I'm not even going to ask... just let me have it.
entries.translation: 我甚至都不想问了……直接告诉我吧。

entries.source: There is a corrupted Ticon space weapon here.  It was another experimental system that I thought the Ticon never actually deployed but obviously did.
entries.translation: 这里有一件被侵蚀的泰肯太空武器。这是另一套实验系统，我原以为泰肯人从未真正部署过它，但显然他们部署了。

entries.source: We've faced their tech before, this can't be any worse.
entries.translation: 我们以前就面对过他们的科技，情况再糟也不过如此了。

entries.source: You may be right.  The station appears to be malfunctioning and operating in a much diminished capacity.  Its targeting sensors are destroyed as well.  So whatever it fires, it will be firing randomly into space.
entries.translation: 你说的可能没错。该空间站似乎发生了故障，运作效能大打折扣。它的瞄准感应器也被摧毁了。所以无论它发射什么，都只是在向太空中胡乱扫射。

entries.source: Is that Ticon space station also acting as a Warp Inhibitor?
entries.translation: 那座泰肯空间站也起到了跃迁抑制器的作用吗？

entries.source: Yes... oddly so.  That is very strange since Warp Inhibitors were developed after the Ticon empire. Someone must have added the inhibitor to the station after it was built and corrupted.
entries.translation: 是的……真奇怪。这太反常了，因为跃迁抑制器是在泰肯帝国灭亡后才被研发出来的。肯定是有人在空间站建成并被侵蚀后，又加装了抑制器。

entries.source: Perhaps someone wanted to protect access to the wormhole beyond this system?  No matter... we're taking it out.  Any assault advice?
entries.translation: 也许有人想封锁通往该星系外虫洞的通道？无所谓了……我们要把它彻底摧毁。有什么进攻建议吗？

entries.source: None... it isn't clear how you will assault that heavily defended world fragment or reach the station.
entries.translation: 没有……目前尚不清楚你该如何强攻那片防御严密的世界碎片，或怎样接近空间站。
太棒了……我最喜欢挑战了。

entries.source: This world is barely being held together.  It's near the end for this world.... geological forces have torn it apart, and disturbances in this system have done the rest.
entries.translation: 这个世界几乎已经分崩离析了。它已经大限将至……地质力量将其撕裂，而这个星系中的动荡完成了致命一击。

entries.source: This world has been uninhabited for over a billion years, so the artifacts must have been dropped here more recently.
entries.translation: 这个世界已经荒废了十亿多年，所以这些神器肯定是最近才被遗落在这里的。

entries.source: There is also another matter of concern here, Skars.  I show an Air Exclusion (AE) structure on that hill to the south west.
entries.translation: 这里还有另一件令人担忧的事，斯卡斯。我检测到西南方向的山丘上有一座防空禁飞（AE）建筑。
是泰肯还是塞洛伊的技术？

entries.source: Neither.  This technology is actually ancient and comes from the 3rd C.E.... the civilization that came after yours.  It was supposed to be a technology to block spores, but...
entries.translation: 都不是。这项技术其实相当古老，来自第3纪元……也就是你们之后的那个文明。它原本是用来阻挡孢子的技术，但是……

entries.source: Let me guess, it didn't block spores for long and the Creeper altered it for its own purposes.
entries.translation: 让我猜猜，它没能阻挡孢子太久，反而被爬行体改造并挪为己用了。

entries.source: Yes, now it simply blocks your air units.  You can't use Strafers or Bombers over the area covered by the AE field.
entries.translation: 没错，现在它只会压制你的空中单位。在禁飞场覆盖的区域内，你无法使用扫射机或轰炸机。

entries.source: Great... it will take pure ground operations to take that hill then.  Are Berthas and mortars affected?
entries.translation: 太棒了……看来拿下那座山丘只能完全靠地面部队了。贝尔莎加农炮和迫击炮会受影响吗？

entries.source: No, they slip in under the field... just barely.  So you are only prevented from using Air units under the area covered by the AE field.
entries.translation: 不会，它们的弹道正好能从力场下方擦过……勉强可以。所以只有禁飞场覆盖范围内的空中单位会受到限制。

entries.source: Let's grab the artifacts and get out of here before the whole world disintegrates...
entries.translation: 赶紧带上神器离开这里，趁整个世界还没彻底解体……

entries.source: I believe you are familiar with an Alien race known as the Styglek?
entries.translation: 我想你应该熟悉一个名为斯蒂格莱克的外星种族吧？

entries.source: Yes, they were a once powerful and noble species that fell to the Creeper and were forced to serve the Loki.  A few of them rebelled and those rebels assisted our survival against the second Nexus menace.
entries.translation: 是的，他们曾是一个强大而高贵的物种，后来沦陷于爬行体并被迫为洛基效力。他们中的少数人发起了反抗，正是那些叛军帮助我们在第二次枢纽危机中幸存了下来。

entries.source: I believe "Thrade" was the leader of these rebels?
entries.translation: 我记得“色拉德”是这些叛军的领袖？

entries.source: It would seem that the rebellion did not progress as originally intended.  This Message Artifact references the Styglek, Thrade, and the failed Styglek rebellion to stop the Loki.
entries.translation: 看来反抗并没有像最初设想的那样发展。这个信息神器提到了斯蒂格莱克、色拉德，以及那场试图阻止洛基但最终失败的斯蒂格莱克叛乱。
这条信息是什么时候记录的？

entries.source: It is difficult to date, and very badly damaged, but it seems to have been recorded sometime after the Seloi were long gone.  Sometime around the 300th C.E. perhaps.
entries.translation: 年代很难测定，而且损毁严重，但看起来是在塞洛伊消逝很久之后的某个时间记录的。大概在第300纪元左右吧。

entries.source: The message is a historical volume recording the stories of a single Styglek that returned to the then Milky Way galaxy.  Most of the message is missing, but apparently one Styglek fled the destruction of their kind and returned with a message.
entries.translation: 这条信息是一部历史文献，记录了一位返回当年银河系的斯蒂格莱克族人的经历。信息大部分已经遗失，但显然有一名斯蒂格莱克人在其同族毁灭后逃出，并带回了一条信息。

entries.source: So the Styglek failed and were exterminated by the Loki.  Just like all things, they too eventually were destroyed.
entries.translation: 所以斯蒂格莱克人失败了，被洛基灭绝了。正如万物一样，他们最终也难逃毁灭。

entries.source: It seems more complex than that, Skars.  It would appear the Styglek eventually just ended their rebellion on their own accord.
entries.translation: 情况似乎比这更复杂，斯卡斯。斯蒂格莱克人似乎最终只是自愿终止了反抗。

entries.source: Why, what makes you say that?
entries.translation: 为什么这么说，你发现了什么？

entries.source: The message the Styglek survivor carried to humanity was, "The Arc is everything... everything that ever was or will be. Once you truly comprehend this, you will free your minds from the burden of resistance.  Remember us as the ones who woke up."
entries.translation: 那位斯蒂格莱克幸存者带给人类的信息是：“弧就是一切……过去与未来的一切存在。一旦你真正领悟了这一点，你的心灵就会从抵抗的重担中解脱出来。请将我们铭记为觉醒之人。”

entries.source: One that appears to have been lost over time.  This message was recorded using a one-time pad as a key... and that key was included with this message. But, the key was written onto the message millions of years after the message was originally recorded.
entries.translation: 而且似乎随着时间的推移已经被遗忘了。这条信息是用一次性密码本作为密钥记录的……而那个密钥就附在这条信息中。但是，这个密钥是在该信息最初记录的数百万年之后才被写上去的。

entries.source: So someone or something kept the decryption key a secret and only included it eons later.  And of course the whole thing was on an artifact the Creeper bypassed.
entries.translation: 所以有人——或者某种存在——一直保守着解密密钥的秘密，直到亿万年后才把它附上。当然，整件事都记录在一个被爬行体绕过的神器上。

entries.source: Lia.... we are on the verge of a great realization, I can feel it in my.... That's odd.
entries.translation: 莉娅……我们即将迎来一个伟大的顿悟，我能深深地感觉到……真奇怪。

entries.source: Never mind that now Skars, lets get out of here and move on to Vapen and take out the Warp Inhibitor.
entries.translation: 现在别管那个了，斯卡斯。我们快离开这里前往瓦彭，摧毁那里的跃迁抑制器。

entries.source: I was afraid of this.  I had hoped it had all been deactivated...
entries.translation: 我最担心的就是这个。我还以为它们全都被停用了……

entries.source: This is Tiplex, a machine world.  It was engineered by the Ticon Empire as a defensive outpost.
entries.translation: 这里是蒂普莱克斯，一个机械世界。它是由泰肯帝国建造的防御前哨。

entries.source: The 'Ticon Empire'?  One of the many human civilizations that arose?
entries.translation: “泰肯帝国”？众多兴起过的人类文明之一？

entries.source: Yes, they were but one civilization, but they developed in a very militaristic way.  They developed massive weapon systems. Entire planets were turned into weapons.
entries.translation: 是的，他们只是其中一个文明，但走向了极度军国主义的道路。他们研发了庞大的武器系统，将整个行星都改造为了武器。

entries.source: Their conflict with the Creeper lasted centuries, longer than any other civilization.  But the costs were unthinkable.  And in the end, they failed like all the others.
entries.translation: 他们与爬行体的战争持续了几个世纪，比任何其他文明都要长。但付出的代价无法估量。最终，他们也和其他文明一样陨落了。

entries.source: The Ticons developed a weapon system they believed would destroy the Creeper once and for all.  It was an artificial, self-replicating structure that derived its sustenance from Emitters.  It was believed this would 'immunize' worlds from Emitters.
entries.translation: 泰肯人曾研发出一种他们认为能彻底消灭爬行体的武器系统。那是一种人工合成、可自我复制的结构，以发射源为食。他们曾以为这能让世界对发射源“免疫”。

entries.source: For a while, and to a measure.  It worked until the emitters were somehow changed.  The emitters adapted to the parasite and turned this weapon, which the Ticon called "Digitalis", into an asset.  Emitters no longer appeared to lose any viability when surrounded by Digitalis.
entries.translation: 在一段时间内，某种程度上是奏效的。直到发射源不知为何发生了异变。发射源适应了这种寄生生物，并将这种被泰肯人称为“数字生化质”的武器反收为己用。发射源在被数字生化质包围时似乎不再损失任何活力。

entries.source: How did the Ticon people cope?

They didn't.  The Digitalis had allowed them to survive the Creeper for decades, but in one moment it became their undoing.  Once the emitters adapted, the Digitalis no longer destroyed them.  Instead it would grow and protect the emitters.
entries.translation: 他们根本无法应对。数字生化质曾让他们在爬行体的威胁下存活了数十年，但在顷刻间却成了他们的毁灭之因。发射源一旦适应，数字生化质就不再摧毁它们，反而会生长并保护发射源。

entries.source: And it appears as if this Digitalis still exists...
entries.translation: 看来这种数字生化质至今依然存在……

entries.source: With regret, it seems so.  Skars, the Digitalis is a brutish and simple enemy.  It spreads along predefined pathways.  But, those paths don't respect terrain elevation.  Digitalis is tough, very tough, and your weapons will have difficulty damaging it.
entries.translation: 遗憾的是，事实正是如此。斯卡斯，数字生化质是个残暴而单纯的敌人。它沿着预设的路径蔓延，但这些路径无视地形高程。数字生化质非常坚韧，你的武器很难对它造成伤害。

entries.source: What is worse is that The Digitalis replicates rapidly and will fill in destroyed areas with great efficiency.  Your best strategy is to try to cut it off from its source.  Digitalis requires a connection to an emitter to thrive.  If you sever that connection, it will cease to grow and eventually wither.
entries.translation: 更糟的是，数字生化质的复制极其迅速，能高效地填补被破坏的区域。你最好的策略是切断它与源头的连接。数字生化质需要与发射源保持连接才能繁茂。只要切断连接，它就会停止生长并最终枯萎。

entries.source: Digitalis also conducts Creeper rapidly and with no loss. So beware of this as it can move Creeper over higher terrain.
entries.translation: 数字生化质还会高速且无损耗地传导爬行体。对此务必小心，因为它能将爬行体运送到更高地形上。

entries.source: If it conducts Creeper, then I suppose Anti-Creeper is also conducted by it?
entries.translation: 既然它能传导爬行体，我想反爬行体也能被它传导吧？

entries.source: Indeed.  Anti-Creeper is conducted as well.  Anti-Creeper also slows the regeneration of Digitalis, so use that to your advantage when possible.
entries.translation: 没错。反爬行体同样能被传导。反爬行体还能减缓数字生化质的再生，尽可能善用这一点。

entries.source: I see there is a Tech Artifact on this world.  It appears it will allow the control of a second Command Node...
entries.translation: 我看到这个世界上有一件科技神器。看来它能让我们控制第二个指挥节点……

entries.source: This will be indispensable on this mission, Skars.  Collect that tech artifact, then land a second Command Node.  This will allow a two front approach and you may be able to take out the emitters that are sourcing the Digitalis.
entries.translation: 斯卡斯，这在本次任务中至关重要。收集那件科技神器，然后降落第二个指挥节点。这样就能两线推进，你或许就能摧毁滋养数字生化质的发射源了。

entries.source: This is most unusual, Skars.  Message Artifacts almost never survive contact with the Creeper.  This one seems strangely immune. It's almost as if the Creeper intentionally does not destroy certain objects.
entries.translation: 这极不寻常，斯卡斯。信息神石在接触爬行体后几乎不可能完好无损。但这一个似乎奇迹般地免疫了。简直就像爬行体故意不摧毁某些特定物体一样。

entries.source: I will require some time to process the contents, it isn't exactly encrypted but it isn't in any recognized format either.  I should have it processed by the time we reach the next star system...
entries.translation: 处理其内容需要一些时间，它算不上被加密了，但也并非任何已知格式。等我们抵达下一个星系时，我应该就能处理完毕了……

entries.source: Land on the right side of the map and collect the Tech Artifact.
entries.translation: 降落在地图右侧并收集科技神器。

entries.source: You can now deploy a second Command Node onto the battlefield.\nClick the Orbital tab and select the second Command Node.\nLand it on the other side of the map.
entries.translation: 你现在可以将第二个指挥节点部署到战场上了。\n点击轨道标签页并选择第二个指挥节点。\n将其降落在地图的另一侧。

entries.source: Take out the two emitters sourcing the Digitalis.\nThe ultimate goal is to destroy the Inhibitor in the center of the map.
entries.translation: 消灭为数字生化质提供源头的两个发射源。\n终极目标是摧毁地图中央的抑制器。

entries.source: You can hide the white Digitalis growth area by pressing\nthe Visibility Button, then unchecking 'Show D-Growth'.
entries.translation: 你可以点击“可见性”按钮，\n然后取消勾选“显示数字生化质生长区”，以隐藏白色的生长区域。

entries.source: Oh My... this world is Ormos. It was occupied by the very last human civilization.  That civilization went to extreme and extraordinary measures to survive the Creeper.
entries.translation: 天哪……这个星球是奥尔莫斯。曾有人类最后的文明在此居住。那个文明为了从爬行体手中存活下来，采取了极其极端且非同寻常的手段。

entries.source: I don't understand why so many civilizations would rise and fall.  How was the Creeper always able to return?
entries.translation: 我不明白为什么会有那么多文明兴起又覆灭。爬行体究竟是如何每次都能卷土重来的？

entries.source: Patience.  Extreme patience.  When a civilization has existed for hundreds of thousands, even millions of years with no hint of the Creeper, it forgets.
entries.translation: 耐心。极度漫长的耐心。当一个文明延续了数十万年、甚至数百万年，且完全不见爬行体的踪影时，它就会逐渐淡忘。

entries.source: So the Loki would just wait?  After eons had passed, they would send the Creeper again?
entries.translation: 所以洛基就只是干等着？度过漫长岁月后，再把爬行体派出来？

entries.source:
That was one component to their strategy...
Skars, this world was altered during the final conflict.  It was a military outpost specifically designed to withstand the Creeper.
entries.translation:
那是他们策略的一部分……
斯卡斯，这个世界在最后的冲突中被改造过。它是一座专门为了抵御爬行体而建的军事前哨。

entries.source: Scanners show no emitters on this world.  It must have worked somehow!
entries.translation: 扫描显示这个世界上没有发射源。看来改造奏效了！

entries.source: So they thought.  There are no emitters but there is still Creeper.  It is trapped inside a subspace rift and will explode onto the terrain once activity is detected.
entries.translation: 他们本来是这么以为的。这里虽然没有发射源，但依然有爬行体。它被困在亚空间裂隙中，一旦检测到活动就会喷涌到地表上。

entries.source: The final humans here managed to alter some physical constants in this region of space.  As such, the Creeper flows more slowly than normal.
entries.translation: 留守在这里的最后这批人类设法改变了这片太空区域的部分物理常数。因此，爬行体的流动速度比平时要慢。

entries.source: With no emitters, our only goal is to collect the Tech Artifacts and the Shield Key.  I'll get to that...
entries.translation: 既然没有发射源，那我们唯一的目标就是收集科技神器和护盾钥匙。我这就去办……

entries.source: Yes, but Skars... don't underestimate this Creeper.  The Tech Artifacts here are for a Siphon and a Terp.  The siphon will let you extract resources from Resource Packs.
entries.translation: 是的，但斯卡斯……千万别小看这些爬行体。这里的科技神器是虹吸器和地形改造仪。虹吸器能让你从资源包中抽取资源。

entries.source: Even after all these eons, there are still some Energy Packs on this world.  Build siphons on them as soon as possible to access their energy.
entries.translation: 即便利经万世，这个世界上依然留有一些能量包。尽快在上面建造虹吸器来获取能量。

entries.source: The Terp will allow you to terraform the land.  I recommend you repair the damage to the walls of the old ruins.  That will keep the Creeper at bay while you build up offensive strength.
entries.translation: 地形改造仪能让你改变地貌。我建议你修复旧遗迹破损的墙壁。这样能在你积蓄进攻力量的同时挡住爬行体。

entries.source: Once you build a Terp, the Terraform Section of your Command Interface will appear.  Just click that button and paint the terrain in a few places to raise or lower it.  Any nearby Terps will then go to work.
entries.translation: 建造地形改造仪后，指挥界面的地形改造栏就会出现。只需点击该按钮，在几个位置涂抹地形即可升高或降低地面。附近的地形改造仪随后就会开始工作。

entries.source: Alright, Lia.  Let's get this done.
entries.translation: 明白了，莉娅。我们开始吧。

entries.source: Build Siphons on the Resource Packs.\nThe Green Crystals will give you energy in this map.\nOn other maps, other resources may be available.
entries.translation: 在资源包上建造虹吸器。\n这张地图中的绿水晶会为你提供能量。\n在其他地图上，可能会有其他资源。

entries.source: Build Terps to terraform land.\nBuild around 5 terps now.\nSpread them around near the edge of the old ruins.
entries.translation: 建造地形改造仪来改造地形。\n现在建造大约5台地形改造仪。\n将它们分散布置在古老废墟的边缘附近。

entries.source: Remember, you only need to destroy the Inhibitor to secure this world!
entries.translation: 记住，你只需摧毁抑制器即可确保这个世界的安全！

entries.source:
Click the Terraform Button then paint where to change the terrain.
Nearby Terps will automatically act on nearby terrain.
Select a brush size of 1, and a terrain height of 9.
Fill in the gaps in the ruin walls and watch the Terps terraform the land.
entries.translation:
点击“地形改造”按钮，然后在要改变地形的位置涂画。
附近的地形改造仪会自动改造周边的地形。
选择笔刷大小为 1，地形高度为 9。
填补遗迹墙体的缺口，观察地形改造仪改造地貌。

entries.source: You are quickly coming to recognize worlds... good.  This world was used by the Ticon Empire, but it appears to be more than a simple outpost.
entries.translation: 你辨认世界的能力越来越强了……很好。这个世界曾被泰肯帝国使用过，但它看起来不仅仅是个简单的前哨站。

entries.source: There is a large structure to the south east and what look like old Totems to the north west? Totems?
entries.translation: 东南边有一个巨大的建筑，西北边看起来像是旧图腾？图腾？

entries.source: Yes, Totems from your age.  Your people used Totems to open rifts into Rift-Space.  But, Rift-Space was long ago destroyed, and the Ticons had a hand in that.
entries.translation: 是的，属于你那个时代的图腾。你的人民曾用图腾打开通往裂隙空间的裂隙。但裂隙空间很久以前就被摧毁了，而泰肯人对此难辞其咎。

entries.source: Totems were built by the Ticon people to produce Aether.  Aether is formed from the remnants of Rift-Space, so Totems are able to extract it.
entries.translation: 图腾由泰肯人建造，用来生产以太。以太是由裂隙空间的残余凝聚而成的，因此图腾能够将其提取出来。

entries.source: That large structure, do you recognize it?  How does it relate to the Totems?
entries.translation: 那座庞大的建筑，你认得它吗？它和那些图腾有什么关联？

entries.source: It appears to be a Ticon Forge.  I've scanned the schematics so will need some time to fully process them.  But, take control of that structure and we should be able to upgrade various capabilities.
entries.translation: 看起来像是一座泰肯锻造厂。我已扫描其图纸，需要一些时间来完全解析。不过，控制那座建筑后，我们应该就能升级多项能力。

entries.source: The Forge will require Aether, so secure and supply energy to those Totems once you secure the Forge.
entries.translation: 锻造厂需要以太，所以占领锻造厂后，务必控制并向那些图腾供能。

entries.source: Upgrade?  Weapons, production, packet speed, things like that I hope...?
entries.translation: 升级？武器、产能、能量包传输速度，希望是这类升级吧……？

entries.source: Precisely things like that.  I'll need time to bring all of the systems on-line, Skars.  So you will have limited upgrades on this world, but what I am able to bring on-line should prove useful.
entries.translation: 正是这类升级。斯卡斯，我需要时间让所有系统上线。所以你在这个世界上能获得的升级有限，但我能上线的那些应该会很有用。

entries.source: I don't see much of great difficulty here, just a couple emitters around the Forge and the Totems.  I should be able to rush in without issue.
entries.translation: 我看这里难度不大，锻造厂和图腾周围只有几个发射源。我应该能直接突进，毫无问题。

entries.source: There is a Ticon structure in that base area to the north east.  Be very cautious, some of the things they experimented with were very dangerous.  If that structure is still active, it may defend itself.
entries.translation: 东北方基地区域有一座泰肯建筑。务必小心，他们进行过的某些实验极度危险。如果那座建筑仍处于激活状态，可能会进行自我防御。

entries.source: It has also been compromised by the Creeper, so whatever it originally did it's a safe bet it does something that benefits the Creeper now.
entries.translation: 而且它已被爬行体侵蚀，因此无论它原本有什么用途，现在很可能都只会对爬行体有利。

entries.source: Alright Lia, I'll proceed with caution and secure this world.
entries.translation: 好的，莉娅，我会谨慎行事，夺下这个世界。

entries.source: This 'warp' travel is strange to me...
entries.translation: 这种“跃迁”旅行对我来说很陌生……

entries.source: Yes, you only ever knew travel through Rift Space.  Rift Space was sealed many millennia ago in an attempt to stop the Creeper menace from returning.
entries.translation: 是的，你以前只了解通过裂隙空间的旅行。为了阻止爬行体威胁卷土重来，裂隙空间在数千年前就已经被封印了。

entries.source: Unfortunately, it did not work.  The Creeper arrived in vessels that could bend the fabric of space-time.  Eventually, the few survivors of successive civilizations developed their own warp technology.
entries.translation: 不幸的是，这并没有奏效。爬行体搭乘能够扭曲时空结构的飞船抵达。最终，历代文明的少数幸存者也研发出了他们自己的跃迁技术。

entries.source: But no matter how strong and advanced each civilization grew, the Creeper would always eventually return.
entries.translation: 但无论每个文明变得多么强大和先进，爬行体最终总会卷土重来。

entries.source: But this ship was constructed before those events.  Platius must have known about warp travel and that this ship would need it.
entries.translation: 但这艘飞船是在那些事件之前建造的。普拉提乌斯一定早就知道跃迁旅行，并料到这艘飞船会需要它。

entries.source: Yes, but... things weren't that simple.  For now concentrate on gaining access to Starsync.  That's where the Warp Inhibitor is in this system.
entries.translation: 是的，但是……事情没那么简单。目前先专注于进入“恒星同步”。这个星系的跃迁抑制器就在那里。

entries.source: I see it at 'Starsync' but it is shielded....  The threat these people faced must have been truly terrifying.  Looks like Telos is our only option.  I'll fly the ship there and initiate ground actions.
entries.translation: 我在“星步”看到了，但它被护盾保护着……这些人曾面临的威胁一定非常可怕。看来泰洛斯是我们唯一的选择了。我这就开飞船过去并展开地面行动。

entries.source: Another shattered world.  The last I heard from this world, it was a thriving new colony.  There is likely little here of interest.
entries.translation: 又一个破碎的世界。关于这里的最新消息，还停留在它曾是一处欣欣向荣的新殖民地。这里恐怕没什么有价值的东西了。

entries.source: Don't be so hasty... your Gel circuits must need recalibrating.  I see a Message Artifact and a Tech Artifact on the scanners.
entries.translation: 别这么早下结论……你的凝胶电路肯定需要重新校准了。我在扫描仪上看到了一个信息神器和一个科技神器。

entries.source: Yes.... yes... you are correct.  Not sure why I overlooked those.  Perhaps I need to perform Gel maintenance again.
entries.translation: 是的……是的……你说得对。不知道我怎么会忽略掉那些。也许我该再做一次凝胶维护了。

entries.source: There also appears to be an odd anomaly in space.  Subspace-slip emitters appear to be floating between the asteroids and space seems warped there!
entries.translation: 太空中似乎还存在某种奇怪的异常现象。亚空间滑移发射源正悬浮在小行星之间，那里的空间似乎被扭曲了！

entries.source: I have few records of the Creeper ever acting in this fashion.  It is possible to warp space this way, but so far from a gravity well... it would require immense energy.  The mass energy of entire stars would be required....
entries.translation: 我鲜少见到爬行体会以这种形式活动。以这种方式扭曲空间是可行的，但远离引力井……这需要极其庞大的能量。必须耗费整颗恒星的质能才行……

entries.source: I can only recommend that you stay clear of that area.  With that much Creeper collapsing into a small region of space, I'm not sure what the results might be.
entries.translation: 我只能建议你远离那个区域。如此大量的爬行体坍缩进一小片空间区域，我无法确定会产生怎样的后果。

entries.source: The Tech Artifact doesn't show any signatures of Ticon or any other civilization we have encountered.... it appears to be a rather mundane tech.
entries.translation: 这个科技神石没有显示出泰肯或我们遇过的任何其他文明的特征……看起来只是一项相当普通的技术。

entries.source: The Guppy tech... I have been hoping we would encounter this.  Simple as the tech may be, it should prove very useful across these asteroids.  Guppies confine and contain packets for remote delivery.
entries.translation: 孔雀鱼技术……我一直希望能遇到它。这项技术虽然简单，但在这群小行星间会非常有用。孔雀鱼可以装载并容纳数据包进行远程运送。

entries.source: Ahhh... very clever.  So we can use them to build structures remotely where our network can't reach.  That will allow us to build nullifiers on those small asteroids that have Spore Towers on them.
entries.translation: 啊……真聪明。这样我们就能用它们在我们网络无法覆盖的地方远程建造建筑了。这样我们就能在那些有孢子塔的小行星上建造消除器了。

entries.source: Speaking of Spore Towers, my circuits are now operating properly and I have reviewed the scans. The wreckage of this world is littered with Spore Towers.  You will need to bring Beam defenses on-line rapidly. Collect the Guppy Tech Artifact, and eliminate the spore threat as soon as possible.
entries.translation: 说到孢子塔，我的回路现在运转正常，并且我已经审查了扫描结果。这个世界的残骸上布满了孢子塔。你需要尽快让光束防御上线。收集孔雀鱼科技神石，并尽快消除孢子威胁。

entries.source: I have also managed to enable a few more tech upgrades in the Forge.  Use those to your advantage.
entries.translation: 我还成功在锻造厂中解锁了更多科技升级。利用它们来获取优势吧。

entries.source: I'm glad your circuits are working well again... I hope that whatever spatial anomalies are present in this system aren't affecting you...
entries.translation: 很高兴你的回路又恢复正常了……希望这个星系存在的任何空间异常都不会影响到你……

entries.source: This is fascinating...  This artifact contains an instruction manual for the Guppy, volumes of literature, art, and video from old Earth, and a treatise from the 144th C.E. on the prospects of cyclical eternity.
entries.translation: 真不可思议……这个神器中包含一份孔雀鱼的操作手册、来自旧地球的大量文学、艺术与影像资料，以及一篇写于第144纪元、关于周期性永恒前景的论文。

entries.source: An odd collection of materials?  Scan through it all looking for anything unusual.
entries.translation: 真是奇怪的内容组合。全部扫描一遍，看看有没有什么反常之处。

entries.source: The treatise on cyclical eternity was written during the time of the Seloi, the sole civilization that ever contacted the Loki.  The treatise proposes something that is most certainly impossible.
entries.translation: 那篇关于周期性永恒的论文写于塞洛伊时代，塞洛伊是唯一曾与洛基接触过的文明。这篇论文提出了一种绝无可能成立的设想。

entries.source: The Seloi were prone to works of great imagination and often developed entire disciplines devoted to the study of theories they knew to be false.  So this is likely one of their many fanciful creations.
entries.translation: 塞洛伊人极具想象力，经常开辟整个学科去专门研究他们明知是错误的理论。所以这很可能只是他们众多奇思妙想中的一件。

entries.source: Be that as it may, indulge me with some details.
entries.translation: 即便如此，还是给我讲讲细节吧。

entries.source: The treatise proposes that our universe is but one of many... nothing new there, this idea dates back to the 1st C.E.  It goes on to argue that it is possible to create a device... something unique and singular to each universe.
entries.translation: 论文提出，我们的宇宙只是众多宇宙之一……这倒不算新鲜，该观点早在第1纪元就有了。论文接着论证说，有可能制造出某种装置……某种对每个宇宙而言都是独一无二的造物。

entries.source: Unfortunately, the document stops after that and no more details are available.  It looks simply like the message was cut off.
entries.translation: 遗憾的是，文档到这里就戛然而止了，没有提供更多细节。看起来像是信息被切断了。

entries.source: Any hints of where the rest of the message may be?
entries.translation: 有线索能找到信息的其余部分吗？

entries.source: Nothing.  In all likelihood, this was a partial copy and the rest of the treatise is lost forever.
entries.translation: 毫无线索。极有可能这只是一份残卷，论文的其余部分已彻底遗失。

entries.source: Shield Keys and other Artifacts must be connected\nto a Command Node to be collected.\nGuppies can not collect them.
entries.translation: 护盾钥匙及其他神器必须连接到\n指挥节点才能被收集。\n孔雀鱼无法收集它们。

entries.source: Telos... this is a world that has been silent for over 100 thousand earth standard years.
entries.translation: 泰洛斯……这是一个沉寂了十万多个地球标准年的世界。

entries.source: Lia, do you have any additional information about why I was brought to this time?  It seems as if the Creeper has destroyed everything we ever worked to save...
entries.translation: 莉娅，关于我为什么会被带到这个时代，你还有更多的信息吗？看起来爬行体已经摧毁了我们曾经为之奋斗拯救的一切……

entries.source: I only have the star map we are following.  If more information is available, it is locked away and inaccessible in my gel circuits.
entries.translation: 我只有我们目前遵循的星图。如果有更多信息，它们也被锁定在我的凝胶电路深处，无法访问。

entries.source: (Perhaps this is my punishment.  Perhaps I died many years ago...  could this be the mythological cursed realm of Helheim my ancestors believed in? Impossible...)
entries.translation: （也许这就是对我的惩罚。也许我很多年前就已经死了……难道这就是我祖先信仰的神话中被诅咒的海姆冥界？不可能……）

entries.source: Skars, there is a Reactor Tech Artifact on this world.  Pick that up as soon as possible.  We can use it to generate energy in confined regions.
entries.translation: 斯卡斯，这个世界上有一个反应堆科技神石。尽快拿到它。我们可以用它在狭窄区域产生能量。

entries.source: I see there is also a shield key here.  I'll destroy the three emitters and collect that key...
entries.translation: 我看到这里还有一把护盾钥匙。我会摧毁这三个发射源并取得钥匙……

entries.source: Collect the Reactor Tech Artifact at the bottom of the map.
entries.translation: 收集地图底部的反应堆科技神器。

entries.source: Reactors produce energy like collectors, but can be tightly packed.\nYou will need to build around 10 Reactors for this mission.\nBuild only a couple at a time till your energy production increases.
entries.translation: 反应堆和收集器一样可以产生能量，但可以紧密排列。\n本任务中你需要建造大约10座反应堆。\n在能量产量提升前，每次只建造两三座。

entries.source: Power Zones are left when you destroy enemies.\nMove units onto the glowing circular Power Zones to get extra abilities.
entries.translation: 消灭敌人后会留下能量区。\n将单位移动到发光的环形能量区上可获得额外能力。

entries.source: Now defeat all emitters to secure this world.
entries.translation: 现在消灭所有发射源来确保这个世界的安全。

entries.source: You no doubt remember one epoch of this world.  Far York was a mighty world and served as the center of commerce for 13 different civilizations.
entries.translation: 你无疑还记得这个世界的某一个纪元。遥远约克曾是一个强盛的世界，担任过13个不同文明的贸易中心。

entries.source: It's nothing but cratered ruins now.
entries.translation: 现在它只剩下一片弹坑累累的废墟。

entries.source: Toward the end of its final occupation, the surviving humans scorched the planet with orbital mass drivers. It was an effort to... I suppose it doesn't matter now.
entries.translation: 在其最后一次被占领的末期，幸存的人类动用轨道质量加速器将这颗星球夷为焦土。他们试图……我想现在这也不重要了。

entries.source: Scanners show a Mortar Tech Artifact on this world.  That should prove very useful against the emitters in the craters.
entries.translation: 扫描仪显示该世界上有一个迫击炮科技神器。用来对付弹坑里的发射源应该会非常有用。

entries.source: Why isn't this ship already equipped with this weapon technology?
entries.translation: 为什么这艘船上没有预先配备这种武器科技？

entries.source: It once was, but many things happened over the course of billions of years.  This ship isn't the original, I have had to reconstruct and rebuild it many times.  Each reconstruction was performed carefully and slowly, so as to not be discovered.
entries.translation: 曾经配备过，但在数十亿年的岁月中发生了许多变故。这艘船并非原版，我不得不对它进行过多次重构与重建。每一次重建都进行得小心翼翼且缓慢，以免被发现。

entries.source: I'll ask more about that later.  For now, lets take out these emitters and pick up that shield key.
entries.translation: 这件事我稍后再问。眼下，我们先摧毁这些发射源，并拿到护盾钥匙。

entries.source: Mortars damage creeper that is deep.\nMove several mortars around each crater\nand they will suppress the creeper.
entries.translation: 迫击炮可以对较深层的爬行体造成伤害。\n将几门迫击炮部署到弹坑周围，\n它们就能压制爬行体。

entries.source: The terrain meter in the command bar at the bottom right of the screen\nshows the terrain height and creeper levels under the mouse.
entries.translation: 屏幕右下方指挥栏中的地形表\n会显示鼠标所在处的地形高度与爬行体厚度。

entries.source: At last, we have lowered the shield and gained access to this world.  Lia, perform a quick scan.  What are the Loki up to?
entries.translation: 终于，我们降下了护盾，进入了这个世界。莉娅，快速扫描一下。洛基在搞什么鬼？

entries.source: I detect no Loki, or other life forms.  Everything here is an automated machine system.  It's a massive effort, though.
entries.translation: 未探测到洛基或其他生命形式。这里的一切都是自动化机械系统。不过，规模相当庞大。

entries.source: What is going on, what is being built?
entries.translation: 发生了什么？正在建造什么？

entries.source: Give me a moment...  This isn't good at all.  I think I understand part of what is going on.
entries.translation: 给我一点时间……情况非常不妙。我想我明白一部分原委了。

entries.source: There are automated ore harvesters here that are constructing a 'Prism' ship.  That ship's sole purpose is to focus Aether from a Totem.  Several civilizations experimented with this kind of tech but on a much smaller scale...
entries.translation: 这里有一些自动化矿石采掘机，正在建造一艘“棱镜”飞船。那艘飞船唯一的用途就是聚焦来自图腾的以太。曾有几个文明尝试过这类技术，但规模要小得多……

entries.source: Whoever designed this ship has managed to create a massive Prism ship.  There is also a heavily altered Totem in the north east.  It's covered by some protective armor as well.
entries.translation: 无论这艘飞船的设计者是谁，他们成功建造了一艘巨型棱镜飞船。在东北方向还有一个经过大幅改造的图腾，上面还覆盖着某种防护装甲。

entries.source: What good does focusing Aether do?
Nothing on a small scale.  On a large scale... Ah, I see now.  The signals in this system are focused on this world for a reason.  This is elegant beyond anything I have ever experienced.
entries.translation: 小规模下毫无作用。但在大规模下……啊，我明白了。该星系中的信号聚焦于这个世界是有原因的。这种精妙程度超越了我所见过的任何事物。

entries.source: The signals present in this system are near the information capacity for this region of space, it wouldn't be possible to put more information in a volume of space bounded by a smaller surface area...
entries.translation: 当前星系中存在的信号已接近该空间区域的信息容量上限，在表面积更小的空间体积内，根本不可能容纳更多信息……

entries.source: The only way to get more information density is to increase the apparent surface area of space and Aether is extra-dimensional....
entries.translation: 获取更高信息密度的唯一途径就是增加空间的视表面积，而以太是超维度的……

entries.source: So that Prism ship can receive the signals being directed at this system, then pack the information into a smaller region of space than is otherwise possible?
entries.translation: 所以那艘棱镜飞船能接收定向发送至这个星系的信息，然后将它们压缩进一个超出常规的小空间里？

entries.source: And then it is my suspicion that it will transmit all of that information via an Aether beam through the remnants of Rift space.  That's the only purpose I can foresee.  I do believe the results of this transmission will have one other effect...
entries.translation: 然后，我怀疑它会通过以太光束，穿透裂隙空间的残留区域来传输所有这些信息。这是我能预见的唯一目的。而且我认为这次发射还会带来另一个后果……

entries.source: If that Prism Ship is allowed to launch and create an Aether Beam over the enhanced Totem in the north east... if that happens... the resulting Aether back-blast will destroy this entire star system.
entries.translation: 如果任由那艘棱镜飞船发射，并在东北方向的强化图腾上方射出以太光束……要是真发生这种事……随之而来的以太反冲将摧毁整个恒星系。

entries.source: Well, we better not let that happen Lia.  Perhaps if we destroy this ship it will also cripple whatever the Loki are trying to accomplish.
entries.translation: 好吧，我们绝不能让这种事发生，莉娅。也许摧毁这艘飞船，也能彻底挫败洛基人的图谋。

entries.source: I wish I could concur, Skars.  But based on what we saw on Otrav, the amount of information in the signals, and the size of this facility.... I...
entries.translation: 我也希望能同意你的看法，斯卡斯。但结合我们在奥特拉夫看到的景象、信号包含的信息量，以及这处设施的规模……我……

entries.source: I believe this world is but one of perhaps millions like it.  Skars, the visible universe must be covered with millions of worlds just like this one all building Prism Ships to focus information and transmit it.
entries.translation: 我认为这个世界不过是数以百万计同类世界的其中之一。斯卡斯，整个可观测宇宙中恐怕遍布着数百万个类似的世界，它们都在建造棱镜飞船来汇聚并传输信息。

entries.source: (Sigh)... This is all so much bigger than us, Lia.  How can we ever hope to stop this....?
entries.translation: （叹气）……这规模远超我们的想象，莉娅。我们究竟要怎样才能阻止这一切……？

entries.source: We can start by surviving here and now.  If we don't destroy that Prism Ship, we will most certainly be destroyed.
entries.translation: 我们可以从活过此时此刻开始。如果不摧毁那艘棱镜飞船，我们必死无疑。

entries.source: Alright Lia, tomorrow holds little promise, but today won't be our final day.  I promise you that.
entries.translation: 好吧，莉娅。明天或许希望渺茫，但今天绝不会是我们的末日。我向你保证。

entries.source: This system looks nearly empty.  It almost looks like a place forgotten by time...
entries.translation: 这个星系看起来几乎是一片死寂。简直就像一个被时间遗忘的地方……

entries.source: This system once hosted many planets and was a center of commerce, entertainment, and industry.  But over time it all faded.  With each passing civilization, fewer and fewer worlds were recolonized.
entries.translation: 这个星系曾经拥有许多行星，也是商业、娱乐与工业的中心。但随着时间的流逝，这一切都烟消云散了。随着文明的更迭，被重新殖民的世界越来越少。

entries.source: Eventually, most of the worlds were destroyed, or deorbited.  Now, only one world remains.
entries.translation: 最终，大部分世界都被摧毁或脱离了轨道。如今，只剩下一个世界了。

entries.source: I see this world is Inhibiting further warp travel, though the readings are strange.  What lies beyond this system?
entries.translation: 我发现这个世界正在抑制进一步的跃迁飞行，不过读数有些异常。这个星系之外到底有什么？

entries.source: It's a wormhole to the Prospector Zone!  I lost track of this wormhole many eons ago.  I see it parked itself outside this little system.
entries.translation: 这是一个通往探矿者星区的虫洞！在数个纪元前我就跟丢了这个虫洞。看来它停驻在了这个小星系的外围。

entries.source: This zone was a region of space known to later civilizations as a place of great riches and unknowns.  The wormhole leading to it was discovered in the early Common Eras and different civilizations would use the worlds in various ways.
entries.translation: 后来的文明将这片星区视为蕴藏无尽财富与未知的宝地。通往它的虫洞在通用纪元早期就被发现了，不同的文明曾以各种方式利用其中的世界。

entries.source: Some civilizations would place their most valuable weapons there, and others would go there to retrieve those same weapons....
entries.translation: 有些文明会把他们最珍贵的武器藏在里面，而另一些文明则会前往那里搜寻那些武器……

entries.source: I'll engage operations at Krig and take out whatever is inhibiting further warp travel.
entries.translation: 我会在克里格展开行动，消灭阻碍进一步跃迁的一切阻碍。

entries.source: There is also a shield key on Krig, so collect that.
entries.translation: 克里格上还有一把护盾钥匙，记得把它带上。
