entries.source: I'll do that.  Perhaps we can return later and explore the region of space on the other end of that wormhole.  For now, I sense our mission lies elsewhere.
entries.translation: 我会的。也许以后我们还能回来，探索虫洞另一端的星域。但眼下，我感觉我们的使命在别处。

entries.source: At last, we have access to the Inhibitor in this system.  Unfortunately, this world is a disaster.
entries.translation: 终于，我们可以接触到这个星系的抑制器了。不幸的是，这个世界已经彻底被毁了。

entries.source: It appears terrible weapons were used that ripped the world apart.  As you are seeing, humanity went to every extreme in its fight with the Creeper.
entries.translation: 看来这里曾使用过可怕的武器，将整个世界撕裂。如你所见，人类在与爬行体的抗争中走到了极端的境地。

entries.source: The nightmare these people must have experienced... unimaginable.
entries.translation: 这些人经历的噩梦……难以想象。

entries.source: I'm not sure what approach would be best here Skars.... wait, I detect two Tech Artifacts.  Excellent....
entries.translation: 我不确定这里最好采取什么策略，斯卡斯……等等，我探测到了两个科技神石。太好了……

entries.source: I see them on the scanners.  Ore Miner and Sprayer?
entries.translation: 我在扫描仪上看到了。是采矿机和喷射器？

entries.source: Yes, build ore mines on those ore deposits you see.  They will send ore to the Command Node.  From there, it will be processed into Anti-Creeper.
entries.translation: 是的，在你看到的矿脉上建造采矿机。它们会把矿石运送到指挥节点。在那里，矿石将被加工成反爬行体。

entries.source:
Ahhh yes, Anti-Creeper.  It was my daughter Alia.... (sigh)
It was my daughter Aliana, who unlocked the secrets of Anti-Creeper long ago.
entries.translation:
啊，没错，反爬行体。那是我女儿阿莉娅……（叹气）
很久以前，正是我女儿阿莉安娜解开了反爬行体的秘密。

entries.source: I assume the Sprayer will deliver Anti-Creeper to the battlefield?
entries.translation: 我猜喷射器就是用来将反爬行体投放到战场的吧？

entries.source: Maintenance?  Now?  Looks like some things have not changed in 5 billion years...  I'll get right to work on taking out this Inhibitor while you perform 'maintenance' on your gel circuits.
entries.translation: 维护？偏偏在现在？看来有些事情即使过了50亿年也毫无改变……趁你对凝胶电路进行“维护”时，我先去着手消灭这个抑制器。

entries.source: NOTE*** If necessary, you may move the map with:\nRIGHT MOUSE, ARROW KEYS, or WASD keys.\n You may zoom the map with: MOUSE WHEEL or Q and Z keys.
entries.translation: 提示*** 如有需要，你可以通过以下方式移动地图：\n鼠标右键、方向键或WASD键。\n你可以通过鼠标滚轮或Q/Z键缩放地图。

entries.source: Build Ore Mines on the Ore Deposits to collect ore.\nOre can be used to make Anti-Creeper.\nAnti-Creeper destroys Creeper on contact.
entries.translation: 在矿床上建造矿井以采集矿石。\n矿石可用于制造反爬行体。\n反爬行体接触爬行体时会将其消灭。

entries.source: Build Sprayers to make Anti-Creeper.\nDeploy sprayers near Creeper and they will fire blobs into the Creeper.\nThis can be useful for securing a beachhead.
entries.translation: 建造喷射器来制造反爬行体。\n在爬行体附近部署喷射器，它们会朝爬行体发射液滴。\n这对建立滩头阵地很有帮助。

entries.source: Remember, you only need to destroy the Inhibitor to secure this world!
entries.translation: 记住，你只需摧毁抑制器即可确保这个世界的安全！

entries.source: This has to be a Ticon world....
entries.translation: 这里一定也是泰肯世界……

entries.source: It once was, but the technology here is different and not exactly Ticon in origin.  It's more recent and seems to be in perfect working order.
entries.translation: 曾经是的，但这里的技术有所不同，并非完全源自泰肯。它是更近代的产物，而且似乎处于完美的运作状态。

entries.source: Perhaps a later civilization updated it and kept it working.
entries.translation: 也许是后来的文明更新了它，并让它保持运转。

entries.source: That could have been true.  But Skars, this equipment seems to have been built very recently.  Perhaps in the last 100 years.  The last human civilization has been gone far longer than that.
entries.translation: 本有可能如此。但斯卡斯，这台设备似乎是在不久前才建造的，大概就在过去100年内。而人类最后的文明覆灭的时间，远比那要久远得多。

entries.source: There appear to be three Power centers, those blocky structures.  Each is connected via a power conduit to three parts of a central station.  My guess is all three parts have to be active for it to function.
entries.translation: 看起来有三个能量中心，就是那些块状结构。每个都通过能源导管连接到中央站的三个部分。我推测必须同时激活所有三个部分，它才能正常运转。

entries.source: And how do we bring the Power Centers online?
entries.translation: 那我们要怎么让这些能量中心上线？

entries.source: Scans show they are in pristine condition and not being damaged by the Creeper.  If they work via the same technology as Fractal Collectors, it may be as simple as clearing out all of the Creeper from around each Power Center.
entries.translation: 扫描显示它们处于完好状态，并未受到爬行体的损坏。如果其工作原理与分形收集器相同，那可能只需清除每个能量中心周围的所有爬行体即可。

entries.source: And that should activate the central station... the thing we don't know anything about.
entries.translation: 这样就能激活中央站了……那个我们一无所知的玩意儿。

entries.source: Yes.  I can say that even though this equipment is new and in perfect condition, it does not appear to be much more than some sort of testing facility.  The power produced by those Power Centers just isn't enough to do too much damage, regardless of what it actually does.
entries.translation: 是的。我敢说，尽管这台设备很新且完好无损，但它看起来不过是某种测试设施。不管它的实际功用是什么，那些能量中心产生的能量根本不足以造成太大破坏。

entries.source: That's encouraging... I think.  Well, let's flip the switch on this thing and see what happens.
entries.translation: 这真令人鼓舞……大概吧。好吧，让我们合上这东西的电闸，看看会发生什么。

entries.source: I don't know if this is good or bad.
More ancient historical volumes... more references to the "Arc"?
entries.translation: 更多古老史籍……更多关于“方舟”的记载？

entries.source: I've never seen this form of data encoding before, it is very complex.... nearly perfect and recorded at an atomic scale with incredible fault tolerance.  But, I can still resolve most of the content and translate it.
entries.translation: 我以前从未见过这种数据编码形式，非常复杂……近乎完美，以原子尺度记录，且容错率高得惊人。不过，我依然能解析出其中的大部分内容并进行翻译。

entries.source: It seems to be a technical specification for the field device on this world.  I was right, this tech was a test for a part of a device being constructed elsewhere.
entries.translation: 这似乎是该星球上野外设备的技术规格说明。我猜得没错，这项技术只是在别处建造的某种设备部件的测试版本。

entries.source: And who built this equipment and recorded the message?
entries.translation: 那么，是谁建造了这些设备并记录了这段信息？

entries.source: Skars, the designator that appears within the contents appears to translate to; "16th Transient Regiment, 4th Ephemeral Division, Loki Hive".
entries.translation: 斯卡斯，内容中出现的标识翻译过来似乎是：“洛基蜂巢，第4短暂师，第16瞬态团”。

entries.source:
My Gods... the Loki are here.  

Now, I know my purpose.
entries.translation:
天哪……洛基人在这里。

现在，我知道我的使命了。

entries.source: I didn't notice that object on the scanners till we got closer...  so I've emergency steered the ship to a counter orbit away from the proto-Magnetar.
entries.translation: 直到靠近后我才在扫描仪上注意到那个物体……所以我已紧急转向，使飞船进入反向轨道，远离了那颗原磁星。

entries.source: That red orb in orbit around this world?  It seems to have a massive gravitational and magnetic field.
entries.translation: 轨道上绕着这个星球运转的那个红色球体？它似乎拥有极强的引力和磁场。

entries.source: It's a piece of a left over magnetar... an artificial magnetar at that.  It was used in an attempt to construct a Dyson sphere around this system.  Which in turn was another failed attempt to hide from the Creeper.
entries.translation: 那是一颗残留下来的磁星碎片……而且还是一颗人造磁星。曾有人试图利用它在这个星系周围建造戴森球。那也不过是又一次试图躲避爬行体的失败尝试。

entries.source: It's effect on the Creeper should be of concern.  Creeper is attracted by its intense gravitational field, so it should flow toward the Magnetar.  But the Magnetar is orbiting the world...
entries.translation: 它对爬行体的影响值得警惕。爬行体会受到其强大引力场的吸引，因此理应涌向这颗磁星。但磁星正在环绕这个星球公转……

entries.source: So there will be a massive Creeper tide from helheim... that's what you are saying.
entries.translation: 所以届时会爆发一场来自地狱般的爬行体巨浪……你是这个意思吧。

entries.source: Yes, in short that is correct.  The good news is that you can use the fully available tech upgrades to help deal with the uncertain situation on the ground.
entries.translation: 是的，简而言之就是这样。好消息是，你可以利用现已完全解锁的技术升级，来应对地面上的不可测局势。

entries.source: Also... proximity to the Magnetar has allowed me to enable a special ability on the Forge.  Rather than just being used for special upgrades, the forge can now attempt to activate the Totems and open a portal to Rift Space.
entries.translation: 另外……靠近这颗磁星让我得以激活锻造厂的一项特殊能力。锻造厂如今不仅能用于特殊升级，还可以尝试激活图腾，开启通往裂隙空间的传送门。

entries.source: But you said Rift Space was destroyed.
entries.translation: 但你说过裂隙空间已经被摧毁了。

entries.source: Indeed it was.  But the attempt to open Rift Space will create a temporary opening to a realm of immense gravity.  This 'Singularity Weapon' is accessible from the Forge menu.  Be cautious, though, it uses immense amounts of Aether.
entries.translation: 确实如此。但尝试打开裂隙空间会撕开一道短暂的裂口，连通一个拥有极强引力的领域。这项“奇点武器”可在锻造厂菜单中启用。不过要小心，它会消耗极其庞大的以太。
你刚才顺口提到了“瓦罗”。

entries.source: This Message Artifact appears to have been written by 'Varro Hale' who lived in your time.  The message says he was friends with 'Dax Joven' and went on to head the Command Academy on Colony Prime among other minor historical facts.
entries.translation: 这件信息神器似乎是由生活在你那个时代的“瓦罗·黑尔”所写。信息中提到他是“达克斯·乔文”的朋友，后来担任了母星殖民地指挥学院的院长，此外还记录了一些细碎的历史细节。

entries.source: Yes!  Colony Prime... it seems like I just left there Lia...  Without Dax and Varro, we would never have rebuilt humanity... nothing that came after would have been possible.
entries.translation: 是的！母星殖民地……莉娅，感觉我才刚刚离开那里不久……若没有达克斯和瓦罗，我们永远不可能重建人类文明……之后的一切都不复存在。

entries.source: That is certainly correct, Skars.  If you and the others had failed there would not have been the thousands of civilizations and trillions of lives that followed.  They all owe you and the others a debt of gratitude.
entries.translation: 确实如此，斯卡斯。如果你和其他人当年失败了，就不会有后来的数千个文明和数万亿条生命。他们都欠你和其他人一份恩情。

entries.source: Debt? It was all for nothing Lia.  NOTHING!  Everything is gone.
entries.translation: 恩情？一切都白费了，莉娅。毫无意义！所有的一切都没了。

entries.source: Anything else in the message recoverable other than Varro's curriculum vitae?
entries.translation: 除了瓦罗的个人履历，信息里还能复原出别的什么吗？

entries.source: Just one fragment; It reads, "... and without the tutelage, guidance, and guile of Admiral Skarsgard Abraxis, we never would have eventually discovered Aliana's true gifts".
entries.translation: 只有一段残片；上面写着：“……若没有斯卡斯加德·阿布拉克西斯上将的教导、指引与谋略，我们永远不可能最终发现阿利亚娜真正的天赋”。

entries.source: Aliana's true gifts?  What does that mean?  Aliana, my daughter???
entries.translation: 阿利亚娜真正的天赋？这是什么意思？阿利亚娜，我的女儿？？？

entries.source: Lia, this world seems familiar.  I recognize that central structure and the surrounding stations.
entries.translation: 莉娅，这个星球看起来很眼熟。我认得那个中央结构和周围的空间站。

entries.source: I... I'm not sure.  Are there any signs of the Loki?  Perhaps this is their doing and all some sort of deception?
entries.translation: 我……我也不确定。有洛基的踪迹吗？也许这是他们的手笔，一切都只是某种骗局？

entries.source: Nothing, Skars.  Nothing at all.  After everything we have been though, all I detect are cold machines.  But, machines with a purpose I now clearly understand.
entries.translation: 什么都没有，斯卡斯。什么都没留下。历经了这一切后，我侦测到的只有冰冷的机器。但是，我现在清楚地理解了这些机器的目的。

entries.source: You see it too, then.  These six stations are receiving incomprehensible amounts of data from across the universe, and they are feeding it to a central core.
entries.translation: 那看来你也感觉到了。这六座基站正从全宇宙接收难以估量的数据，并将它们输送给核心。

entries.source: I just do, Lia.  I see things now....  That central core is constructing what the Seloi called the 'Arc Eternal', and the Loki were right to react to knowledge of it.
entries.translation: 我就是能感觉到，莉娅。我现在能看清许多事物了……中央核心正在构建塞洛伊人所谓的“永恒之弧”，而洛基对此知情后的反应是正确的。

entries.source: Yes, from all that I have learned I see this as well.  But I still don't fully understand the purpose of the Arc.
entries.translation: 是的，根据我所了解的一切，我也看到了这一点。但我仍然不完全理解这巨弧的目的。

entries.source: The Arc is a universal singleton, Lia.  Something of which only one may exist.  There can be no other, and once made it cannot be unmade.  The Arc forms an absolute reference point across all of space, time, and alternate eventualities.
entries.translation: 永恒之弧是全宇宙唯一的特异存在，莉娅。独一无二。它无可替代，且一旦造就便不可逆转。巨弧构成了横跨所有时空与可能性的绝对参照点。

entries.source: How is such a thing possible?  How is such a thing even possible to construct... and how do you...?
entries.translation: 这种事怎么可能存在？构建这种东西怎么可能做到……你又是怎么……？

entries.source: It isn't being constructed, it is simply being revealed.  It exists through all of space and time for this universe, Lia.  Once revealed, it will provide access to any time, any location, even alternate eventualities.
entries.translation: 它并非在被构建，而只是在被揭示。它贯穿于这个宇宙的整个时空，莉娅。一旦被揭示，它将提供通往任何时间、任何地点，甚至是平行可能性的通道。

entries.source: Every decision, every decay of every subatomic particle, every choice, every random event spread across the entire history of the universe are all mapped to a fabric.  That fabric has its origin in the Arc.
entries.translation: 全宇宙历史中的每一个决定、每一个亚原子粒子的衰变、每一个选择、每一个随机事件，都被映射成了一张织锦。而这张织锦的源头，就在永恒之弧。

entries.source: To reveal the Arc requires knowledge of a massive amount of space and time.  Don't you see Lia?  Don't you see now?
entries.translation: 要揭示永恒之弧，需要知晓庞大到不可思议的时空信息。难道你还不明白吗，莉娅？你现在还不明白吗？

entries.source: I...  how do you know all of this Skars?
entries.translation: 我……斯卡斯，你是怎么知道这一切的？

entries.source: The Creeper's purpose wasn't simply to destroy, it was to record.  It collected knowledge of everything it touched and it remembered.  Trillions and trillions of worlds covered with Creeper across billions of years, harvesting information...  Can't you see how elegant and beautiful that was, Lia?
entries.translation: 爬行体的目的不仅仅是毁灭，更是记录。它收集所接触过的一切知识并铭记下来。数十亿年间，数以万亿计的世界被爬行体覆盖，收割着信息……莉娅，难道你看不出那是多么优雅而美丽吗？

entries.source: Humans and their many civilizations were a bounty of complexity.  An ever renewing fountain of information.... but there were many others in many other galaxies.  Now, all of that knowledge will finally allow the Loki to pinpoint and reveal the Arc Eternal.
entries.translation: 人类及其无数文明曾是一座复杂的宝库。是源源不断的信息源泉……但其他星系中还有更多。现在，所有这些知识终于能让洛基精确定位并揭示永恒之弧了。

entries.source: And we should stop this, Skars.... Right?
entries.translation: 而我们应该阻止这一切，斯卡斯……对吧？

entries.source: Yes.... yes, of course.  Access to the Arc would allow the Loki total mastery of everything.  They could rewrite the course of events in this universe.  This must be prevented.
entries.translation: 是的……是的，当然。获得永恒之弧的掌控权将让洛基主宰一切。他们能够改写这个宇宙的所有进程。必须阻止这一切。

entries.source: From what I can determine, it should be as simple as taking those six stations offline.  They are processing incoming Aether beams using a technology that I don't understand.  But, their power source is simple... they need Creeper to function.
entries.translation: 根据我的判断，做法应该很简单：让那六座基站离线。它们正在利用一种我不理解的技术处理传入的以太光束。但是，它们的动力源很简单……它们需要爬行体才能运作。

entries.source: So, clear away the Creeper from the stations and they go offline.  That will buy us some time, then we can destroy those stations with nullifiers and prevent the Loki from revealing the Arc.
entries.translation: 所以，只要清除基站周围的爬行体，它们就会下线。这能为我们争取一些时间，然后我们就可以用消除器摧毁那些基站，阻止洛基揭示永恒之弧。

entries.source: Seloi Science Academy, Standing Council Directors
entries.translation: 塞洛伊科学院常务理事会理事们

entries.source: Newton Mont: "Council, our team has confirmed your suspicions."
entries.translation: 牛顿·蒙特：“各位理事，我们团队已证实了你们的猜想。”

entries.source: Council Director 2: "Then it is true. The Arc exists."
entries.translation: 理事会理事 2：“这么说那是真的了。永恒之弧确实存在。”

entries.source: Further, we have identified two means by which it may be revealed.
entries.translation: 此外，我们还确定了两种可能将其揭示的方法。

entries.source: One, we believe, is being employed by the Loki."
entries.translation: 我们认为，其中一种正被洛基所利用。”

entries.source: Council Director 4: "So, the Creeper and the Arc are intertwined?"
entries.translation: 理事会理事 4：“这么说，爬行体与永恒之弧彼此交织？”
牛顿·蒙特：“看来确实如此。

entries.source: We also believe the Loki are aware of only one method to reveal the Arc."
entries.translation: 我们还认为，洛基只知道揭示永恒之弧的其中一种方法。”

entries.source: Council Director 1: "And how have you reached these conclusions, Director Mont?"
entries.translation: 理事会理事 1：“蒙特主管，你是如何得出这些结论的？”

entries.source: Newton Mont: "For this, I present our newest nominee for Research Fellow.
entries.translation: 牛顿·蒙特：“为此，我向大家引见我们最新提名的研究员。

entries.source: His insights led us to our conclusions."
entries.translation: 正是他的真知灼见引导我们得出了这些结论。”

entries.source: Council Director 5: "Bring in this young man.  We wish to question him directly."
entries.translation: 理事会理事 5：“带这个年轻人进来。我们想直接向他问话。”

entries.source: Council Director 3: "What is this man's name, Director Mont?"
entries.translation: 理事会理事 3：“这个人叫什么名字，蒙特主管？”

entries.source: Newton Mont: " 'Platius', Council.  His name is 'Platius Abraxis' "
entries.translation: 牛顿·蒙特：“各位理事，他叫‘普拉提乌斯’。全名是‘普拉提乌斯·阿布拉克西斯’。”

点击可抵达的世界进行导航。
若要扩展网络，请启动任务并完成目标。

entries.source: This mission was made with a more recent version of the game. You should update to the latest game version else the mission may not play properly.
entries.translation: 此任务由更新版本的游戏制作。请更新至最新游戏版本，否则任务可能无法正常游玩。

entries.source: Closing the Game.  Are you sure you want to exit? Game will be auto saved to the 'auto' slot.
entries.translation: 确定要退出游戏吗？游戏将保存到“自动”存档槽。

entries.source: The arc of the moral universe is long,
By the year 13271 in the first Common Era,
humans had spread into a great galactic empire.
entries.translation: 人类已扩张成为一个庞大的银河帝国。

entries.source: All they had achieved ended when the Creeper arrived.
entries.translation: 当爬行体降临时，他们所建立的一切皆化为泡影。

entries.source: Thousands of worlds were destroyed by an unknown enemy.
entries.translation: 数千个世界被未知的敌人毁灭。

entries.source: Yet, a small group of less than 50 thousand humans survived.
entries.translation: 然而，仍有一支不足5万人的微小群体幸存了下来。

entries.source: Their impossible journey ended in the destruction of the
entries.translation: 他们不可思议的征程以摧毁敌方核心枢纽、

entries.source: enemy Nexus and the founding of a new, sole human colony.
entries.translation: 并建立人类唯一的全新殖民地而告终。

entries.source: Thirty years later, the enemy returned.
entries.translation: 三十年后，敌人卷土重来。

entries.source: Yet again humanity held back the darkness.
entries.translation: 人类再次抵挡住了黑暗。

entries.source: A peace that would endure for many millennia was created.
entries.translation: 一段延续了数千年的和平就此开启。

entries.source: But like all things crafted by human hands, it was not to last.
entries.translation: 但正如所有出自人类之手的事物一样，它终究未能永存。

entries.source: Again and again the Creeper would return.
entries.translation: 爬行体一次又一次地卷土重来。

entries.source: Eons would pass between each culling.
entries.translation: 每次清洗之间，沧海桑田，万古流逝。

entries.source: Empires would rise and fall, each more brilliant than the last.
entries.translation: 无数帝国崛起又陨落，一个比一个更加辉煌。

entries.source: But no matter how great humanity became, it would always succumb.
entries.translation: 但无论人类变得多么强大，最终都难逃覆灭。

entries.source: Through it all, one man slept.
entries.translation: 在这漫长岁月中，唯有一人沉睡不醒。

entries.source: His journey on the first great exodus was not to be his last.
entries.translation: 他在初次大迁徙中的航程，并非他的终点。

entries.source: Guarded and watched over for billions of years,
entries.translation: 历经数十亿年的守护与注视，

entries.source: his time to awaken has come.
entries.translation: 他苏醒的时刻终于到来。

entries.source: Now, when the last of the great human empires has
entries.translation: 如今，当人类最后的伟大帝国

entries.source: New or improved score/time. Submit it!
entries.translation: 创造了新纪录！快去提交吧！

entries.source:
The backbone of any network.
 Collects energy based on green soylent field it projects.
entries.translation:
网络的基础。
根据覆盖的绿色区域收集能量。

entries.source:
Relays creates long distance connections,
but only to other Relays.
Relays also double packet speed.
entries.translation:
中继器可建立远距离连接，
但仅限与其他中继器相连。
中继器还会使数据包速度翻倍。

entries.source:
Reactors generate energy.
They can be packed tightly.
entries.translation:
反应堆可产生能量。
建造时可以紧密排列。

entries.source:
Creeper respulsion field.
Can also block spore hits.
entries.translation:
爬行体排斥力场。
还能阻挡孢子袭击。

entries.source:
Ore Mines extract ore from ore deposits.
Ore is used to make Anti-Creeper (AC)
entries.translation:
采矿机从矿床中开采矿石。
矿石用于制造反爬行体（AC）

entries.source: Siphons extract resources from Resource Packs.
entries.translation: 虹吸器从资源包中提取资源。

entries.source:
Terps terraform land.
Paint terrain by pressing the Terraform button.
entries.translation:
地形改造仪用于改造土地。
按下“改造地形”按钮即可绘制地形。

entries.source:
Packet trasporter.
Land in remote locations to provide packets.
entries.translation:
数据包运输机。
降落在偏远地点以输送数据包。

entries.source:
Primary defense weapon.  Fires at nearest Creeper.
Does light damage.
entries.translation:
主要防御武器。向最近的爬行体开火。
造成轻微伤害。

entries.source:
Mortars fire shells that damage deep Creeper.
Mortars do not require line of sight.
entries.translation:
迫击炮发射炮弹打击高浓度爬行体。
迫击炮不需要直视视线。

entries.source:
Strafers are remote strike craft.
Target them at remote Creeper.
entries.translation:
扫射机是远程打击飞行器。
指派它们攻击远处的爬行体。

entries.source:
Bombers deliver AC remotely.
Target them at remote locations.
entries.translation:
轰炸机可远程投送AC。
指派它们前往偏远地点。

entries.source: Device for destroying Emitters and other enemies.
entries.translation: 用于摧毁发射源和其他敌方目标的设备。

entries.source:
Sprayers fire Anti-Creeper.
Sprayers can also collect AC and dispatch as ore.
entries.translation:
喷洒器喷射反爬行体。
喷洒器也可以收集AC并转化为矿石发出。

entries.source: Beams defend against Aerial Spores from Spore Towers.
entries.translation: 光束炮用于防御孢子塔发射的空中孢子。

entries.source: Anti Runner and special enemy unit.
entries.translation: 对抗奔行者和特殊敌方单位。

entries.source:
Upgrade center.
Requires Aether from Totems.
entries.translation:
升级中心。
需要图腾产出的以太。

entries.source:
Super Gun that can hit any part of map.
Does massive damage to Creeper.
entries.translation:
可打击全地图任意区域的超级大炮。
对爬行体造成巨量伤害。

未知的武器技术。
来源不明。

entries.source: Oh this is bad.... There are a ton of emitters here.. and there is no safe location to start operating from...
entries.translation: 噢，这下糟了……这里有大量的发射器……而且根本没有能安全展开行动的地方……

entries.source: Commander, that Emitter on the Black Rock seems to emit Anti-Creeper
entries.translation: 指挥官，黑石上的那个发射器似乎在喷发反爬行体

entries.source: What?! How it comes it does that...
Hey there young girl... I guess you wouldn't remember me at the moment. Commander, take care of her, she'll be important as soon as her memories come back. She got the same foe as you...
entries.translation: 嘿，小姑娘……我想你现在大概不记得我了。指挥官，照顾好她，一旦她恢复记忆，她将至关重要。她和你有着共同的敌人……

entries.source: I... I know that guy... ... ... urgh... I'm sorry...
entries.translation: 我……我认识那个人……呃……对不起……

entries.source:
... He doesn't look too friendly... on the other hand, he's just about saving us... so I will take back my questions... for the moment...
The same foe? The Creeper, but which human does not fight them, heh?
entries.translation:
……他看起来可不太友善……不过话说回来，他刚救了我们……所以我就先不追问了……暂时吧……
共同的敌人？爬行体吗？但又有哪个人类不与它们战斗呢，呵？

entries.source: Just like you she is after their most powerful Nexus. At that moment, I want to hope you're doing better as she has done back then...
entries.translation: 和你一样，她也在追寻它们最强大的枢纽。在那个时刻，我希望你能比她当年的表现更好……

entries.source:
She already fought that Nexus? How it comes?
And if she ... failed, how did she survive that?
entries.translation:
她已经和那个枢纽交过手了？怎么会这样？
而如果她……失败了，她又是怎么活下来的？

entries.source: Patience, Commander. You'll know it all when you need to, or when she remembers. For now, you're better off charging a Nexus, right? For your own sake, trust me once. These Coordinates lead to the only gate to it's Realm.
entries.translation: 耐心点，指挥官。等时机到了，或者等她想起来时，你自然会知道一切。眼下，你最好还是去给枢纽充能，对吧？为了你自己着想，就相信我一次吧。这些坐标通往进入其领域的唯一大门。

entries.source:
I wonder if.... You may call me Zantaros.
Let's see, any reaction...?
entries.translation:
我想知道是否……你可以叫我赞塔罗斯。
看看会有什么反应……？

entries.source: Zantaros...? Sounds familiar.... I ... I think we can trust him... at least for the moment...
entries.translation: 赞塔罗斯……？听起来好耳熟……我……我觉得我们可以信任他……至少眼下可以……

entries.source: I want to hope you're right. We did never yet find a way to charge that Nexus, so I'm willing to do anything. If this is a trap, be sure we will hunt you down.
entries.translation: 希望你是对的。我们迄今还没找到给那个枢纽充能的方法，所以我愿意做任何尝试。如果这是个陷阱，你大可确信我们会追杀你到底。

entries.source: Well, the young girl remembers at least something. I am quite sure, the next time we meet she will know me again... I will leave this Emitter here, maybe it helps you...
entries.translation: 嗯，小姑娘至少还记得些事情。我敢肯定，下次再见面时她一定会重新认出我……我会把这个发射器留在这里，也许对你们有所帮助……

entries.source: We hope you will enjoy your stay, and wish you luck on your training!
entries.translation: 祝你在这里过得愉快，也祝你的训练一切顺利！

entries.source: The phrase "beau geste" is from the French, meaning "a gracious (or fine) gesture".
entries.translation: “Beau geste”一词源自法语，意为“优雅（或美好）的姿态”。

entries.source: In French, the phrase includes the suggestion of a fine gesture with unwelcome or futile consequences.
entries.translation: 在法语中，该短语还暗含着一种虽心意美好，却招致不良或徒劳后果的意味。

entries.source: In English, "geste" is a homophone with "jest," meaning "a joke" or "to joke." As a pun, a "beau geste" may therefore indicate a beautiful (or poignant) joke.
entries.translation: 在英语中，“geste”与“jest”（意为“笑话”或“开玩笑”）谐音。因此作为双关语，“beau geste”也可以指一个美妙（或辛酸）的玩笑。

entries.source: It's also a movie with a desert fortress under attack...
entries.translation: 这也是一部关于沙漠要塞遭受攻击的电影……

entries.source:
Activate all spatial totems to destroy the enemy!
Click each totem or use the number keys to toggle each peg. Moving some pegs unlocks others.  Press "space" to reset the puzzle and zero the game time.
entries.translation:
激活所有空间图腾以消灭敌人！
点击每个图腾或使用数字键来切换各根插销。移动某些插销会解锁其他插销。按“空格键”可重置谜题并将游戏时间归零。

entries.source: This is our testing facility. Here you can test out weapons and discover the power of powerzones. Spores can get pretty intense here so make sure you build a few more beams.
entries.translation: 这是我们的测试设施。在这里你可以测试武器，并发掘能量区域的强大威力。此处的孢子攻击会相当激烈，所以请务必多造几台光束炮。

entries.source: Protect these dunes against the creeper Skars. In 2 minutes a gaint wave of creeper will appear, so get your bertha's ready!
entries.translation: 保护这些沙丘免受爬行体侵袭，斯卡斯。2分钟后将出现巨大的爬行体浪潮，准备好你的贝尔莎加农炮！

entries.source: Scanners show a strange kind of enemy and I don't know what it will do.
entries.translation: 扫描仪侦测到一种奇怪的敌人，我不知道它会做些什么。

entries.source: So I just have to sit and watch? Not a really good option.
entries.translation: 所以我只能坐以待毙？这可不是什么好主意。

entries.source: Well, it will send a large wall of creeper to you. I recommend building stuff that can withstand some creeper or kill the creeper before it reaches you. Remember that units in flight can't get damaged.
entries.translation: 好吧，它会向你席卷而来一道巨大的爬行体之墙。我建议建造能够承受一定爬行体侵蚀的设施，或者在爬行体接近前将其消灭。记住，飞行中的单位不会受到伤害。

entries.source: This place once was knows as tucana. Power up all totems and you'll win.
entries.translation: 这里曾被称为杜鹃座。给所有图腾充能，即可获胜。

entries.source: Hey guys! This was the map created for a Demo of How to create a map! I hope you enjoy it!
entries.translation: 大家好！这张地图是为“如何创建地图”演示而制作的！希望大家喜欢！

entries.source: You should really turn off ammo packets at the start, at least until you've built a few reactors.
entries.translation: 开局时你真的应该先关闭弹药包补给，至少等到你造好了几座反应堆再说。

entries.source: Welcome back to the next simulation map. This map is Simulation Number 57958425. Please Enjoy!
entries.translation: 欢迎回到下一个模拟地图。本图为第 57958425 号模拟。请尽情享受！

entries.source: CAIN, I need a status report of this world.
entries.translation: 该隐，我需要这个世界的状况报告。

entries.source: This world is fittly titled, "Hopping" it has several different islands, all of which have some sort of enemy presense.
entries.translation: 这个世界被恰当地命名为“跳跃”，它由数个不同的岛屿组成，每个岛屿上都存在着某种敌对势力。

entries.source: According to my scanners, the best place to land would be on the bottom left area because the emitter appears to be damaged and won't start untill 60 seconds after we land.
entries.translation: 根据我的扫描，最佳着陆点是在左下角区域，因为那里的发射器似乎受损了，在我们着陆后60秒才会开始运作。

entries.source: Thank you CAIN, I will proceed with caution.
entries.translation: 谢谢你，该隐，我会小心行动的。

entries.source: Is there a way to win this fight, or are you doomed to failure?
entries.translation: 这场战斗有获胜的办法吗，还是说你注定要失败？

entries.source: Very nice, now I'm alone and I have no idea what to do.
entries.translation: 太好了，现在就剩我一个人了，我完全不知道该做什么。

entries.source: Don't worry my friend. Follow my instructions and you'll be fine.
entries.translation: 别担心，我的朋友。听从我的指示，你就会没事的。

entries.source: Land a command node on the central island and build up a base. Attack the four infested islands one by one and take out the structures built there.
entries.translation: 在中央岛屿降落一个指挥节点并建立基地。逐一攻击那四座受感染的岛屿，摧毁建在那里的建筑。

entries.source: Keep defending you base be prepared for enemies of all kinds attacking your base. When you take out one of the four structures, the tower circling around your base will take over it's function.
entries.translation: 持续防守你的基地，做好应对各类敌人袭击基地的准备。当你摧毁四座建筑中的一座时，环绕在你基地周围的防御塔就会接管它的功能。

entries.source: Addictionally, when you nullify one of the four structures, all units on those four islands will die immediatly. Once you've nullified them all, you can take advantages of the totems and power zones.
entries.translation: 此外，当你清除四座建筑中的任意一座时，那四座岛屿上的所有单位都会立即阵亡。一旦将它们全部清除，你就能利用图腾和能量区域了。

entries.source: 2 emitters should appear the the big rocks on the left and the right. Destroy those and you'll pass this test.
entries.translation: 左侧和右侧的大岩石上应该会出现2个发射器。摧毁它们，你就能通过这场考验。

entries.source: Ough, updated systems to handle all the new signals coming from this world. Finally figured them out.
entries.translation: 呼，更新了系统以处理来自这个世界的所有新信号。终于把它们弄明白了。

entries.source: This world is unstable. Build all units in your main base in the center and be prepared to lose all units on other islands. Also remember that before you nullify a tower, make sure your main base is pretty well defended.
entries.translation: 这个世界很不稳定。把所有单位都建造在中央的主基地中，并做好失去其他岛屿上所有单位的准备。另外记住，在清除一座防御塔之前，确保你的主基地有相当严密的防御。

entries.source: Isn't it easier to just sit down and do nothing?
entries.translation: 坐下来什么都不做难道不是更容易吗？

entries.source: No, creeper will pile up and it will take much longer to nulllify the structures. So land down a command node and start building!
entries.translation: 不行，爬行体会越积越多，清除那些建筑会花上更久的时间。快降落指挥节点，开始建造吧！

entries.source: They won't work here, so I temporary removed them from your control panel. Scanners say that the creeper also reacts different here. Experiment to find a way to push back the creeper.
entries.translation: 它们在这里不起作用，所以我暂时从你的控制面板中移除了。扫描器显示这里的爬行体反应也不同寻常。试着找出击退爬行体的方法吧。

entries.source: Once all totems are powered you can start nullifying and I'll enable the nullifiers again.
entries.translation: 一旦所有图腾都充能完毕，你就可以开始清除，届时我会重新启用消除器。

entries.source: These space islands remind me of frosting cookies as a child
entries.translation: 这些太空浮岛让我想起了小时候给饼干抹糖霜的情景
那么扫描器上有什么发现？

entries.source: Scanners are showing something I have not seen before...  I'm checking on it now commander.
entries.translation: 扫描器显示出一种我从未见过的东西……指挥官，我正在进行核查。

entries.source: Scan complete: This area has underground tunnels that emitters will use to dig their way to the surface like in CW2.
entries.translation: 扫描完成：该区域有地下隧道，发射器会利用这些隧道挖出通往地表的路径，就像在CW2中那样。

entries.source: Is CW2 a designation for some other planet? Nevermind, what do you suggest we do?
entries.translation: CW2是某个其他星球的代号吗？算了，你建议我们怎么做？

entries.source: It appears you can use TERPs to slow down their digging procedure, or to cover a hole left behind a nullified emitter.  Also the emitters will use the tunnels to release creeper in other locations.
entries.translation: 看来你可以使用地形改造仪（TERP）来减缓它们的挖掘进度，或者填补消除器清除发射器后留下的洞穴。此外，发射器还会利用这些隧道在其他位置释放爬行体。

entries.source: I have only one thing I can say about this: This is going to be very difficult.
entries.translation: 对此我只有一句话可说：这将会非常艰难。

entries.source: The first spore will come in one minute. Digitalis will slowly enter your base. You might want to enable show digi growth area to see the progress.
entries.translation: 第一枚孢子将在一分钟后到达。数字生化质会缓慢侵入你的基地。你可能需要开启“显示数字生化质生长区域”来观察进度。

entries.source: Any unit near the core will slowly die and lose all ammo, in return, their max health will increase.
entries.translation: 核心附近的任何单位都会逐渐受损并失去所有弹药，但其最大生命值会随之提高。

entries.source: If you manage to kill the tower, 4 copies of the tower will spawn in the corners. So be prepared for a lot of spores. I'll remind you by that time.
entries.translation: 如果你设法摧毁了这座防御塔，角落里会生成4座复制体防御塔。所以做好迎接大量孢子的准备吧。到时我会提醒你的。

entries.source: For now, build out as fast as possible and get a beam online.
entries.translation: 现在，尽快向外拓展，并让光束炮上线就绪。

entries.source: What is this? A new enemy?
No. My records say that in this place humanity tried to kill a single emitter. They used their own cores to create anti-creeper and AC spores, slowly growing stronger and stronger.
entries.translation: 不。我的记录显示，人类曾在这个地方试图消灭单个发射器。他们用自己的核心来制造反爬行体和反爬行体孢子，慢慢变得越来越强。

entries.source: Many years later the creeper returned and it took over their systems.
entries.translation: 多年后爬行体卷土重来，并占领了他们的系统。

entries.source: So I now have to fight something that the humanity made to kill the creeper? Then you might know what it does.
entries.translation: 所以现在我得去对付人类为了消灭爬行体而制造的东西？那你应该知道它是怎么运作的吧。

entries.source: Our nullifiers are not strong enough to destroy it. The core creates a lot of child cores using the energy stored. Those cores will gather some energy on their runs and will return all energy back to the main core after completing their run.
entries.translation: 我们的消除器不够强，无法摧毁它。该核心利用储存的能量制造了大量子核心。那些核心在巡弋途中会收集部分能量，并在巡弋完成后将全部能量带回主核心。

entries.source: Nullify cores to 'drain' some energy of the main core. Once it's energy falls below a point it will sacrifice its immunity against our nullifiers for a small burst of destruction and some extra energy.
entries.translation: 清除子核心可以“抽取”主核心的一部分能量。一旦其能量低于某个临界点，它就会牺牲针对我们消除器的免疫能力，换取一次小范围的毁灭爆发以及一些额外能量。

entries.source: Be prepared for a lot of spores and build a few mortars to keep the creeper density's low.
entries.translation: 做好应对大量孢子的准备，并建造几门迫击炮来抑制爬行体的密度。

entries.source:
Thanks to Virgil for the scripts and images (that i shamelessly "borrowed" from the meso map).
The idols have quite high energy demand, make sure you can run them before you hook them up!
entries.translation:
感谢 Virgil 提供的脚本和图像（我毫不客气地从 meso 地图里“借”来的）。
神像的能量需求相当高，接入之前确保你能带得动它们！

entries.source: go north or go east, it's up to you, but connecting point to point will give you what you need to win. (scripts from meso, thanks again Virgil, i love these powered idols!)
entries.translation: 往北走还是往东走，由你决定，但只要点对点连接起来，就能获得获胜所需的一切。（脚本来自 meso，再次感谢 Virgil，我太喜欢这些充能神像了！）

entries.source: tek tip! packet speed is probably a good idea!
entries.translation: 小贴士！提升数据包速度大概是个好主意！

entries.source: Greetings commander, in this TEST we will be bringing back an aspect of your past....  No nullifires will be allowed in this map.  You will need to connect all totems to win.  Have fun!
entries.translation: 指挥官，你好。在这场测试中，我们将重现你过去的某一阶段……本张地图中不允许使用消除器。你需要连接所有图腾才能获胜。祝玩得开心！

entries.source: Something's wrong - we're coming down right in the pa...
entries.translation: 不对劲——我们正降落在那群……

entries.source: Welcome Back to the Custom Map Series, Simulation. This map is number 258685432. Please Enjoy, it is titled, "The Name".
entries.translation: 欢迎回到自定义地图系列模拟。本图编号为 258685432。祝游玩愉快，地图名为“名字”。

entries.source: This world looks to have an interesting shape in it... "Lich" I wonder what that means.
entries.translation: 这个世界上似乎有一个有趣的形状……“巫妖（Lich）”，不知那是什么意思。

entries.source: Records indicate that this world was based off of a privatly owned planet build to defend against the creeper, unforutonly it failed and proved very hard to take back.
entries.translation: 记录显示，这个世界原本是一颗为抵御爬行体而建的私人星球，遗憾的是它陷落了，而且事实证明极难夺回。

entries.source: The world is covered with lots of enemy units. Be prepared to fight quickly, and smartly!
entries.translation: 这个世界布满了大量敌方单位。做好准备，要打得又快又聪明！

entries.source:
This used to be an ancient human port.
It is no longer in use.
You can see many holes and problems  with the foundation that have formed.
entries.translation:
这里曾是一座古老的人类港口。
现已废弃。
你可以看到地基上形成了许多破洞和缺陷。

entries.source: If it is no longer in use what are those ships doing there?
entries.translation: 如果已经废弃了，那那些飞船在那里做什么？

entries.source: This pit is full of moving drone-bases. Some structures might even create drone-bases.
entries.translation: 这个深坑里满是移动的无人机基地。某些建筑甚至可能会生成无人机基地。

entries.source: The drones will destroy any structure in range immediatly. They will move freely over the map but prefer high ground, but not higher than 8. Try to get them trapped so you can nullify the drone-bases.
entries.translation: 无人机会立即摧毁射程内的任何建筑。它们会在地图上自由移动，但更偏好高地，不过不会高于8级地形。尽量困住它们，这样你就能清除这些无人机基地了。

entries.source: Next dialog will show a hint, click skip all if you don't want a spoiler.
entries.translation: 下一段对话将显示提示，如果您不想被剧透，请点击“全部跳过”。
（能量区 PZ）地形改造器是关键

entries.source: Are you going to let the Creeper push you around?
entries.translation: 你打算任由爬行体对你步步紧逼吗？

entries.source: Welcome to the Creeper Simulation Machine Version 6.1, My name is CS Advanced.  Welcome to your training as a Challenger of the Creeper.
entries.translation: 欢迎来到爬行体模拟器 6.1 版，我是高级 CS。欢迎参加爬行体挑战者训练。

entries.source: Hello Trainee! I am CAIN, Comand Node Artifical Intelligence. I trust that you can get yourself through the mission, so I wil be mostly silent and just take notes on your performance.
entries.translation: 你好，受训者！我是 CAIN，指挥节点人工智能。我相信你能独立完成任务，所以我基本上会保持沉默，只记录你的表现。

entries.source: Mission Report: Many emitters are in this world but you get some high ground to start. Runners and an air tower block your path. Collect the tech artifacts for more assistance on your battle.
entries.translation: 任务简报：这个世界中有许多发射器，不过开局你有一些高地优势。疾行体和一座防空塔挡住了去路。收集科技神器，为你的战斗获取更多援助。

entries.source: Prepare the simulation, I am engaing the creeper in battle!
entries.translation: 准备模拟，我即将与爬行体交战！

entries.source: Simulation Number 84497884 starting please stand by to engage.
entries.translation: 84497884 号模拟正在启动，请准备交战。

entries.source: I have almost completed the simulation. May I recieve my next instructions?
entries.translation: 我差不多完成了这次模拟。能接收下一项指令了吗？

entries.source: You did very well on this mission. The next one won't be so easy however, prepare yourself for a challenging battle.
entries.translation: 你在这次任务中表现非常出色。不过接下来的任务可没这么容易，准备好迎接一场严峻的战斗吧。

entries.source: Simulation Number 84497884 is almost complete preparing to stop simulation machine.
entries.translation: 第 84497884 号模拟即将完成，准备停机模拟设备。

entries.source: There must be something wrong here. That emitter is showing extreme activity.
entries.translation: 这里肯定有问题。那个发射器表现出异常强烈的活动迹象。

entries.source: It recieves energy from unactivated totems. Try to connect (and arm!) all totems before attacking that emitter.
entries.translation: 它从尚未激活的图腾中汲取能量。在攻击那个发射器之前，尽量连接（并装载满能量！）所有图腾。

entries.source: For this simulation, many strategies will be needed, among them the following: Bertha bombardment, guppy transportation, terraforming, and extensive air combat.
entries.translation: 在这场模拟中，需要用到多种策略，包括：巨炮轰炸、运输艇物资转运、地形改造以及大规模空战。

entries.source: You aren't serious about that plan, are you?
entries.translation: 你不会真打算按那个计划来吧？

entries.source: Don't get offensive, if you know any better plan that is doable in our time shedule, i'm fine hearing it.
entries.translation: 别这么冲，如果你在现有时限内能拿出更好的可行方案，我随时愿闻其详。

entries.source:
(Several Hours later)
Our ultimate weapons aren't in shape to fight the enemy directly... he is too strong for taht either. 
We need to get our ranged weapon going.
entries.translation:
（数小时后）
我们的终极武器现状无法直接迎战敌人……对手也太强大了。
我们必须让远程武器运转起来。

entries.source:
7 Minutes until 00.00.
Let Operation Yashima begin.
entries.translation:
距 00:00 还有 7 分钟。
屋岛作战，开始。

entries.source:
(Note: The Enemy Spore Towers will, after they finished building, throw insane amounts of spores at you (10 Spores every 2.5 Seconds)
It's very recommended to build overbuild Beams)
entries.translation: （提示：敌方孢子塔建造完成后，会朝你投掷极其密集的孢子（每 2.5 秒 10 枚孢子）。强烈建议大量建造光束炮）

entries.source: Welcome to the Alpha Sector!  Here you will find a collection of varied and assorted worlds. These maps were made throughout the development of the game by beta testers.
entries.translation: 欢迎来到 Alpha 星区！这里汇集了形形色色、丰富多彩的世界。这些地图由测试人员在游戏开发期间陆续制作。

entries.source: Some maps remain in their original form, others have been updated over time, yet others were updated at the end of game development by the beta testers.
entries.translation: 有些地图保留了最初的面貌，有些历经多次更新，还有些则是在开发尾声由测试人员进行了全面改良。

entries.source: You will find simple worlds, large worlds, super hard hards, testing worlds, puzzle words, maybe even impossible worlds.  Good luck on your journey!
entries.translation: 你会遇到简单的世界、庞大的世界、超难的世界、测试世界、解谜世界，甚至可能是不可能通关的世界。祝你旅途好运！

entries.source: This is a testing simulator of a little game where you have to move the green walls in such a way that they will survive as long as possible. Arrow keys to move. The game will end in 10 minutes. Good luck!
entries.translation: 这是一个微型游戏的测试模拟器，你需要移动绿色墙壁，让它们尽可能久地存活下来。方向键移动。游戏将在10分钟后结束。祝你好运！

entries.source: What's up Creeper World Commanders? This is my very first map I made. This map was created in one of the first builds, it has been remastered for your pleasure. Enjoy, and thanks for playing!
entries.translation: 你们好，爬行体世界指挥官们！这是我制作的第一张地图。本图创建于最早的版本之一，现已重新制作供大家畅玩。祝玩得开心，感谢游玩！

entries.source: I present to you: Warzone! This is the first map I made in one of the earliest builds of the game (way back in alpha!). Here it is, in its most raw form, aside from some added totems, this is the orginal map, just pure Creeper World Chaos! Also check out "War Zone" which is the updated version of this map for maximum madness!
entries.translation: 向大家隆重介绍：交战区！这是我在游戏极早期版本（早在Alpha时期！）制作的第一张地图。除了添加了一些图腾外，它原汁原味地保留了原本的风貌，只有纯粹的爬行体世界大混乱！另外也别忘了体验“War Zone”，那是本图的升级版本，狂乱程度拉满！

entries.source: The first mission from the old alpha versions that seemed impossible. Good luck!
entries.translation: 来自早期Alpha版本、看似不可能完成的第一个任务。祝你好运！

entries.source:
Final component question:
	Turn on exactly one lamp
entries.translation:
元件最后一题：
	恰好点亮一盏灯

entries.source:
Which switches need to be closed to turn the light on?
	A: only A     B: only B     C: none     D: both
entries.translation:
需要闭合哪些开关才能点亮灯泡？
	A: 仅A     B: 仅B     C: 都不闭合     D: 两者都闭合

entries.source:
All lamps are same
	How much energy will each lamp get in one hour?
	A: 45 J     B: 10800 J     C: 162000 J     D: 0.18 kWh
entries.translation:
所有灯泡完全相同
	每盏灯在一小时内会消耗多少能量？
	A: 45 J     B: 10800 J     C: 162000 J     D: 0.18 kWh

entries.source:
You can now skip questions
	Skipping adds 4 seconds to your penalty time and gives you a penalty
	Which component do you have to place at the question mark
	to dim the lamp?
entries.translation:
你现在可以跳过题目了
	跳过会使你的惩罚时间增加4秒并记一次惩罚
	你需要在问号处放置哪个元件
	才能让灯泡变暗？

entries.source:
In the next question you'll have to choose a component that fits in the contraption
	There are four possible answers, they are listed below the letters
	If there are multiple answers possible, you'll have to select them all
	else the answer is wrong
entries.translation:
在下一题中，你必须选择一个适用于该装置的元件
	共有四个备选答案，列在各字母下方
	如果有多个正确答案，你必须将它们全部选出
	否则判为回答错误

entries.source:
Will you be able to see the light from the lamp when the switch closes?
	A: Yes B: No
entries.translation:
当开关闭合时，你能看到灯泡发光吗？
	A：能 B：不能

entries.source:
What will happen when switch A closes?
	A: Short Circuit   B: The lamp will turn on
entries.translation:
当开关 A 闭合时会发生什么？
	A：短路   B：灯泡亮起

entries.source:
So if A is the right answer, you destroy the collector on pad B
	and then you destroy the collector on continue
	If you destroyed the collector on pad A destroy the reset collector
	For this 'question' your penalty won't increase so you can try it out
entries.translation:
因此，如果 A 是正确答案，你就摧毁 B 平台上的收集器，
	然后再摧毁“继续”平台上的收集器。
	如果你误摧毁了 A 平台上的收集器，摧毁“重置”收集器即可。
	这道“问题”不会增加你的惩罚时间，你可以试一下。

entries.source:
Hit continue to check the answer
	If the answer is wrong, you'll get a 4-second penalty
	and you will have to try again
	The penalty increases with one seconds each time
entries.translation:
点击“继续”以检查答案。
	如果答案错误，你将受到 4 秒的惩罚，
	并且必须重试。
	每次重试惩罚时间都会增加一秒。

entries.source:
Destroy all collectors except the one on the right answer
	Destroy the collector on the 'reset' pad to recover all collectors
	Why? There are questions with multuple good answers and
	you can strike out the answers that are wrong
entries.translation:
摧毁除正确答案以外的所有收集器。
	摧毁“重置”平台上的收集器可以复原所有收集器。
	为什么？因为有些问题有多个正确答案，
	你可以先划掉那些错误的选项。
现在清除所有敌方建筑。

entries.source: This button creates 2000 creeper, but only once
entries.translation: 此按钮会生成 2000 爬行体，但仅限一次

entries.source: The left emitter emits creeper proportional to your energy generated
entries.translation: 左侧发射器排放的爬行体与你的发电量成正比

entries.source: The right emitter emits creeper proportional to your ore mined
entries.translation: 右侧发射器排放的爬行体与你的矿石开采量成正比

entries.source: Remember to build a lot of beams and reactors!
entries.translation: 记得多建造一些光束炮和反应堆！

entries.source: The ship is ancient, it must have been preserved for a billion or more years... where, I don't know.  But it is totally useless now, it's crashed and is just fragments.
entries.translation: 这艘飞船太古老了，它一定保存了十亿年甚至更久……至于是在哪里，我不得而知。但它现在彻底没用了，它已经坠毁，只剩残骸。

entries.source: Look at those fragments.  In their midst, the plans for the mightiest vessel ever constructed, the Thor!  We must obtain those schematics, they will hold the secret to destroying the Nexus.
entries.translation: 看看那些残骸。在它们正中，有着有史以来建造的最强飞船——托尔号的蓝图！我们必须拿到那些图纸，里面藏着摧毁枢纽的秘密。

entries.source: Amazing... This ship uses recognizable technology for the most part, though on a massive scale.  But the main cannons... the construction is similar to the Dark Beam of ancient times.
entries.translation: 太惊人了……这艘飞船大部分采用的技术我们都能辨认，只是规模格外庞大。但主炮……其结构与远古时期的暗黑光束极为相似。

entries.source: Yes... of course.  This makes sense.
entries.translation: 是的……当然。这就说得通了。

entries.source: The main cannons appear as though they fire self guided bursts of energy... an energy that will damage the Nexus.  These cannons look as if they are specifically designed for this purpose!
entries.translation: 主炮似乎会发射自导能量脉冲……一种能够伤害枢纽的能量。这些主炮看起来简直就是专门为此而设计的！

entries.source: Of course they were.  The Loki weren't the only ones who knew what would happen.
entries.translation: 那是当然。预料到这一切的可不止洛基一族。

entries.source: But, the Loki have prepared for this possibility, Aliana.  They have surrounded their Nexus with a shield.  This shield is impervious to any of the weapons we have, including the Thor.
entries.translation: 但是，阿利亚娜，洛基早就防着这一手了。他们在枢纽周围布下了护盾。包括托尔在内，我们现有的任何武器都无法穿透这层护盾。

entries.source: Then we are still at an impass...
entries.translation: 那我们岂不是依然束手无策……

entries.source: Platius was always one step ahead... I don't believe he...
entries.translation: 普拉提乌斯向来料敌先机……我不相信他会……

entries.source: ...Father, I think you are right.  The impact of the crashed ship sent tectonic waves through the crust of this world.  I show buried structures here, that may be of use.
entries.translation: ……父亲，我想你是对的。坠毁飞船的冲击力在这颗星球的地壳中引发了构造波。我检测到了这里埋藏的结构体，或许派得上用场。

entries.source: Yes, the structures are the remains of ancient and primitive weapons, missile silos from a primitive culture.  If we terraform down to level 1, we can access these remains.  I can program the nano-construction packets to rebuild them.
entries.translation: 是的，这些结构体是古老原始武器的遗迹，属于某个原始文明的导弹发射井。如果我们把地形平整下挖至1级，就能接触到这些遗迹。我可以对纳米建造数据包进行编程来重构它们。

entries.source: Ah, you are as brilliant now as ever my daughter.  Platius knew this as well...  The missiles will fly into the shield around the Nexus and damage it.  The Loki didn't design the shield for such primitive projectile weapons!
entries.translation: 啊，我的女儿，你一如既往地聪慧。普拉提乌斯也料到了这一点……导弹会穿入枢纽周围的护盾并对其造成破坏。洛基并没有把护盾设计成能防范这种原始的抛射型武器！

entries.source: I'll indicate the location of the silos, Father.  We must secure those locations and terraform them to level 1.  Once excavated, hook up our network and arm the silos.
entries.translation: 我会标出发射井的位置，父亲。我们必须控制这些区域，并将地形平整至1级。挖掘出来后，连接上我们的网络，并为发射井装填弹药。

entries.source: The Thor may not be able to penetrate the Nexus shield, Aliana... but I sure bet it will help secure the area around those missile silos!
entries.translation: 阿利亚娜，托尔也许穿不透枢纽的护盾……但我敢说它绝对能在夺取那些导弹发射井周围的区域时派上大用场！

entries.source: Now Imperator!  Destroy the anomaly's core!
entries.translation: 就是现在，统御者！摧毁异常体的核心！

entries.source: No Father!  This is our last chance!  Remember the good...
entries.translation: 不要，父亲！这是我们最后的机会了！想想那些美好的过去……

entries.source: I remember Aliana...  and I choose ultimate POWER!  Now bear witness to your own undoing!
entries.translation: 我记得，阿利亚娜……但我选择无上的力量！现在，亲眼见证你自己的毁灭吧！

entries.source: Goodbye, Aliana.  I look forward to remaking other versions of you at my leisure!
entries.translation: 再见了，阿利亚娜。我很期待在闲暇时重新创造出你的其他版本！

entries.source: Father, I remember your life and mine... all the good that we did, all of the life that we brought into being.  That can't be erased...
entries.translation: 父亲，我还记得你我的一生……我们所做的一切善事，我们创造的所有生命。那是不可能被抹去的……

entries.source: Already I have begun the cleansing!  Goodbye at last Aliana.  My new universe awaits!
entries.translation: 净化已经开始了！永别了，阿利亚娜。我的新宇宙在等待着我！
该做个了结了，洛基蜂群。

entries.source: Many... eventua... lities... Many... Impera.... toooooor. [Loki Transmission Terminated]
entries.translation: 无数种……可……能性……无数个……统……御者————。[洛基通讯已终止]

entries.source: I'm sorry Imperator... I'm so sorry...  If only you had chosen to remember Skarsgard Abraxis.  I wish there were another way.
entries.translation: 我很抱歉，统御者……我真的很抱歉……要是你当初选择记起斯卡斯加德·阿布拉克西斯该多好。我真希望还有别的办法。

entries.source: Imperator, you mush perish along with the Loki.  But you had the right idea in one respect.  The Arc is now under my protection and with it I will choose to remake some things as I see fit.
entries.translation: 统御者，你必须和洛基一同毁灭。但你在某一点上说得没错。永恒弧现在由我守护，而我将凭借它随心重塑部分事物。

entries.source: Goodbye Imperator.  I shall be with my Father again soon.
entries.translation: 永别了，统御者。我很快就能与父亲重聚了。

entries.source: Your efforts are in vain.  Continue with this annoyance, and we shall show you our true wrath!
entries.translation: 你们的努力毫无意义。再继续这般烦扰我们，就让你们见识真正的愤怒！

entries.source: Prepare yourself for unforeseen eventualities Loki Hive.
entries.translation: 做好准备迎接始料未及的后果吧，洛基蜂群。

entries.source: The shield around the Nexus is down Father!
entries.translation: 枢纽周围的护盾瓦解了，父亲！

entries.source: Now, we will use the main cannons of the mighty Thor and destroy the Nexus!
entries.translation: 现在，我们将动用强大的托尔号主炮，彻底摧毁枢纽！

entries.source: We shall see 'Skarsgard Abraxis' and the 'Anomaly'.  Now witness our true wrath.
entries.translation: 我们走着瞧，“斯卡斯加德·阿布拉克西斯”，还有“异常体”。现在见证我们真正的愤怒吧。

entries.source: This cannot be, Imperator!  Our shield is down and we are vulnerable!
entries.translation: 这绝不可能，统御者！我们的护盾失效了，破绽百出！

entries.source: Aliana!  Stop your assault.  You must join with me so that we may rule over all reality together!
entries.translation: 阿利亚娜！住手！你必须与我联手，这样我们才能一同统治整个现实！

entries.source: And so it is done my daughter.  Ten billion years it has taken, and now I stand as a finite being at last.
entries.translation: 终于结束了，我的女儿。历经整整一百亿年，如今我终于重归为一个有限的生命了。

entries.source: I'm not so sure about that Father.  The Arc once made, cannot be unmade.  It is here and stands at your disposal.
entries.translation: 我对此可不太确定，父亲。永恒弧一旦被铸成，便无法被逆转消弭。它就在这里，任凭你调遣。

entries.source: This is a great power for a finite man.  Perhaps as the Imperator I could...
entries.translation: 对一介凡人而言，这份力量实在太过浩瀚。也许作为统御者，我可以……

entries.source: ...Father, I'm only just beginning to understand this great plan of yours.  But I believe everything that has happened did so as you had planned.
entries.translation: ……父亲，我才刚刚开始理解您的这个伟大计划。但我相信，所发生的一切都是按照您的计划进行的。

entries.source: Perhaps my daughter.  Perhaps I shall choose to believe that.  But even with all that I now know and remember, I'm not sure what to do next.
entries.translation: 也许吧，我的女儿。也许我该选择相信这一点。但即便我现在知晓并回忆起了一切，我也不确定接下来该做什么。

entries.source: The Arc allows you to visit any time, any place, in any alternate reality.  You can go anywhere at any time.
entries.translation: 永恒弧能让您造访任何时间、任何地点、任何平行现实。您可以随时去往任何地方。

entries.source: But where would one go with such choices... who or what would one be?
entries.translation: 但面对这样的选择，一个人又该去往何方……成为谁，或是成为何物？

entries.source: I have an idea Father.  Perhaps you can travel to 10 billion years ago, when the Loki first emerged into greatness.
entries.translation: 我有个想法，父亲。也许您可以前往100亿年前，回到洛基初现伟业之时。

entries.source: Interesting proposition Aliana.  And what will I call myself?
entries.translation: 很有意思的提议，阿利亚娜。那我该自称为什么呢？

entries.source: How about something familiar... something to honor one you always respected.  How about....
entries.translation: 不如用一个熟悉的名字……一个向您一直敬重之人致敬的名字。比如……

entries.source: ...Yes Aliana, you have always been very wise.  I think I shall choose that name during my travels, at least for a while. It is all very clear to me. When I travel to times past, I will simply be called...
entries.translation: ……是的，阿利亚娜，你一向无比聪慧。我想在旅途中，我至少会暂时用这个名字。我心里彻底明朗了。当我回到过去的时光，我便被称为……

entries.source: No!!!!!!  Imperator?!?!  This was not foretold!
entries.translation: 不！！！！！！统御者？！这不是预言中的结局！

entries.source: At last, the Loki speak.  Now that you shall never have access to the Arc, what will you do?
entries.translation: 洛基终于开口了。既然你们永远也无法接触到永恒弧，你们又打算做什么？

entries.source: By destroying the stations, Imperator, you have denied yourself true and full knowledge.  Ultimate power could have been ours!  But no matter.  We will simply begin again.
entries.translation: 统御者，你摧毁了空间站，也就剥夺了你自己获得真正而完全的真知的机会。终极的力量本可属于我们！但这无关紧要。我们重新开始便是。

entries.source: And I will stop you again...
entries.translation: 那我便会再次阻止你们……

entries.source: We will wait another 10 billion years, then another, then another if necessary.  And when we finally reveal the Arc Eternal we will save you, our Imperator.  We will save you... [Loki Transmission Terminated]
entries.translation: 我们会再等100亿年，如有必要，就再等一个又一个100亿年。当我们最终揭示永恒弧之时，我们终将拯救你，我们的统御者。我们将拯救你……[洛基通讯中断]

entries.source: I'm not sure, but perhaps there are other eventualities that the Loki sense.  Something about this all seems uncertain... as if there were other possible outcomes... parallel realities.
entries.translation: 我不确定，但也许多元变局正是洛基所感知到的。这一切似乎都透着不确定……就仿佛存在着其他可能的结果……平行现实。

entries.source: Imperator?  Why did they call you that?
entries.translation: 统御者？他们为什么那样称呼你？

entries.source: That's odd, I didn't even notice.  Oh, 'Lia'... you can drop the charade now.  It is very good to see you again Aliana... very good indeed my Daughter.
entries.translation: 真奇怪，我甚至都没注意到。噢，“莉娅”……你现在可以卸下伪装了。能再次见到你真好，阿利亚娜……真的太好了，我的女儿。

entries.source: When we came to this world, I began to see things more clearly.  As we fought to prevent the Arc from being built, everything became clear to me.  Just as I knew that Lia was but a mask for your true self, I also know that I am no longer a physical being.
entries.translation: 当我们来到这个世界时，我开始看得更清楚了。随着我们奋战阻止永恒弧的建造，一切对我而言都变得明朗起来。正如我知道莉娅只是你真实自我的伪装一样，我也明白自己已不再是一个实体存在了。

entries.source: I wanted to tell you, but... revealing such a thing when you were projecting a physical form... I thought it would be too traumatic.
entries.translation: 我本想告诉你的，可是……在你还在投射实体形态时揭露真相……我觉得那打击会太大了。

entries.source: It makes sense... each of us aren't very different from the Loki, or Platius. We never have been.  We each exist outside a single physical form.  This battle... this success... for some reason it awoke a great wealth of knowledge within me.
entries.translation: 这说得通……我们彼此与洛基或普拉提乌斯并没有太大的不同。一直以来都是如此。我们都存在于单一的实体之外。这场战斗……这次胜利……出于某种原因，唤醒了我体内庞大的知识宝库。

entries.source: This great knowledge I look forward to sharing with you...
entries.translation: 我期待着与你分享这份渊博的知识……

entries.source: And now the Loki have been defeated and a universe stands before us.
entries.translation: 而现在洛基已被击败，整个宇宙展现在我们面前。

entries.source: Yes, my Daughter.  But the Loki will begin again.... so we have much work before us.
entries.translation: 是的，我的女儿。但洛基会卷土重来……所以我们还有很多工作要做。

entries.source: But this time you won't be alone.
entries.translation: 但这一次，你不再是孤身一人了。

entries.source: And for that, my child, I am eternally grateful.
entries.translation: 而为此，我的孩子，我永远心怀感激。

entries.source: Arhhhh!  Imperator, the anomaly has done the unforeseen!
entries.translation: 啊啊啊！统御者，异常体做出了意料之外的举动！

entries.source: That's right... I did what I must to stop you.  I destroyed my orbital ship, and converted it into defenses that will deny you the Arc forever!
entries.translation: 没错……我做了必须做的事来阻止你。我摧毁了我的轨道飞船，并将其转化为防御设施，彻底断绝你染指永恒弧的可能！

entries.source: Ha ha ha... child, your efforts amuse me.  You stand in my shadow like a pebble beneath a mountain.  But I shall still show you mercy.  When these events are complete, I will remake you to serve me as I have promised.
entries.translation: 哈哈哈哈……孩子，你的挣扎真让我发笑。你站在我的阴影下，犹如高山脚下的一粒微石。但我仍会向你展现仁慈。待这桩桩事件尘埃落定，我便会如约重塑你，让你为我效力。

entries.source: We shall see, Imperator.  [Aliana transmission terminated]
entries.translation: 咱们走着瞧，统御者。[阿利亚娜通讯中断]

entries.source: Imperator, the anomaly has scanned our construction at the moment of your merging.  From that it has devised primitive weapons that will damage the shield around our mighty Nexus!
entries.translation: 统御者，那个异常体在您融合的瞬间扫描了我们的造物。它借此设计出了原始武器，能够破坏环绕在我们伟大枢纽周围的护盾！

entries.source: The anomaly has also deployed itself directly over the Arc...  It has created a shield around the Arc, that our weapons will not penetrate!
entries.translation: 那个异常体还直接部署在永恒弧的正上方……它在永恒弧周围构建了一层护盾，我们的武器无法穿透！

entries.source: My children, have I not orchestrated all that has transpired?  Have I not guided you to this moment?  After all that has transpired, you DOUBT me now!?
entries.translation: 我的孩子们，眼前发生的一切难道不全是由我一手策划的吗？难道不是我引领你们走到这一刻的吗？历经了这一切之后，你们现在竟然在“怀疑”我！？

entries.source: Silence!!!  I hold your entire Hive in the palm of my hand and can crush it at will!  Doubt me again, and I will erase your existence from all of history and replace you with another!
entries.translation: 闭嘴！！！你们整个蜂群都捏在我的手心，我想碾碎就碾碎！再敢怀疑我一次，我便将你们从全部历史中抹去，另寻他人取而代之！

entries.source: Yes, Imperator.  We are at your command.
entries.translation: 遵命，统御者。我们听凭您的差遣。

entries.source: Now, do you not see the weakness in her defenses?
entries.translation: 现在，难道你们还没看出她防线上的弱点吗？

entries.source: Yes, Imperator... We see it now.  With your power our Nexus can move more rapidly than we thought possible.
entries.translation: 看出来了，统御者……我们现在看出来了。借助您的力量，我们的枢纽能以超乎想象的速度移动。

entries.source: Yes.  I will guide our Nexus and avoid the primitive weapons.  I will enhance the weapons of the Nexus so that we may destroy the generators powering Aliana's shield.
entries.translation: 没错。我将亲自引导枢纽并避开那些原始武器。我还会强化枢纽的武装，好让我们摧毁为阿利亚娜的护盾供能的发生器。

entries.source: Once her shield is down, I will flood the area with Creeper until she is destroyed!  Then I will control the Arc and all of reality will be at my command!
entries.translation: 一旦她的护盾瓦解，我就会让爬行体淹没整个区域，直至将她毁灭！到那时，我将掌控永恒弧，现实中的一切都将任我差遣！

entries.source: BEHOLD!  All that has transpired has done so exactly as foretold!  The Arc Eternal is revealed at last!  Bear witness to our mighty Nexus!
entries.translation: 看哪！发生的一切全都分毫不差地应验了预言！永恒弧终于现世！见证我们强大的枢纽吧！
做好承受冲击的准备，莉娅！

entries.source: The Loki... at last we meet.
At last, Imperator?  You are still projecting a finite existence.  Open your mind, Imperator.... open your mind.
entries.translation: “终于”吗，统御者？你仍在投射着有限的肉身存在。敞开你的心智吧，统御者……敞开心智。

entries.source: Don't listen to them, Skars.  They....
entries.translation: 别听他们胡说，斯卡斯。他们……

entries.source: SILENCE!  We have silenced your primitive automaton so that we may converse more clearly.
entries.translation: 闭嘴！我们已经让你的原始自动机噤声，以便我们能够更清晰地交谈。

entries.source: She is right Loki, you are trying to deceive me!
entries.translation: 她说得没错，洛基，你在试图欺骗我！

entries.source: Look upon yourself, Imperator.  Truly look upon yourself!  Do you see a finite existence?  Do you see a body made of simple materials?
entries.translation: 审视你自己吧，统御者。真正地审视你自己！你看到的是有限的存在吗？你看到的是由简单物质构成的躯体吗？

entries.source: Yes.  Did you really believe that some automaton had preserved a primitive human form for billions of years?  You know this to be an absurdity.  Now you know your true form.
entries.translation: 是的。你真以为是某个自动机把一个原始人类形态保存了数十亿年？你知道这是多么荒谬。现在你认清自己的真实形态了。

entries.source: But I remember being a child, growing up, living, fighting the Creeper... defeating a Nexus.  Platius saved me....
entries.translation: 但我记得自己童年成长、生活、与爬行体作战……击败枢纽的情景。是普拉提乌斯救了我……

entries.source: Yes, the explosion that the one you call Platius saved you from.  How do you think he was able to do that so 'easily'.  You never needed saving, Imperator!
entries.translation: 是的，被你称为普拉提乌斯的那个人从爆炸中救了你。你以为他是怎么能如此“轻而易举”做到那一切的？统御者，你根本从未需要过拯救！

entries.source: Is it not the one you call Platius that was the deceiver?  What did he tell you of himself and of us?
entries.translation: 难道欺骗者不正是那个被你称为普拉提乌斯的人吗？关于他自己，关于我们，他都对你说了些什么？

entries.source: He told me his people fought you and nearly won.  He told me you were once a great race and that you peered into a dark and alternate realm and found something there that changed you and set you on this path of destruction.
entries.translation: 他告诉我他的族人曾与你们交战且险些获胜。他告诉我你们曾经是一个伟大的种族，但你们窥探了黑暗的异界维度，并在那里找到了某种改变了你们、让你们踏上毁灭之路的东西。

entries.source: And what do you think we found in that 'darkness'?
entries.translation: 那你认为我们究竟在那片“黑暗”中找到了什么？

entries.source: He never said... I'm not sure he ever knew.
entries.translation: 他没说过……我不确定他是否知晓。

entries.source: Ha ha ha ha...  we found YOU, Imperator.  YOU were who we found.  You told us of the Arc and of its potential.  You showed us our purpose and laid out the path for all that would follow.
entries.translation: 哈哈哈哈……我们找到的是你，统御者。我们找到的人就是你。你告诉了我们永恒弧的存在及其潜能。是你向我们揭示了我们的宿命，并铺平了随后发生的一切道路。

entries.source: ...  My body  ...  just a projection of my own choosing ...  I remember now!  I REMEMBER.
entries.translation: ……我的躯体……不过是我自己选择的投影……我想起来了！我想起来了。

entries.source: Father.  It's me, your daughter.  I have been with you all along.  Lia was my projection as I guided you toward the realization of who you really were.
entries.translation: 父亲。是我，您的女儿。我一直都在您身边。莉娅只是我的投影，为了引导您意识到自己究竟是谁。

entries.source: The anomaly, 'Aliana Abraxis'.  Yes, our hive considered that you might appear.  Hiding as an automaton was clever, we grant you this.  We should have detected your presence sooner.  Imperator, you should never have created...
entries.translation: 异常体，“阿利亚娜·阿布拉克西斯”。是的，我们的蜂群曾考虑过你可能出现。伪装成自动机确实很聪明，我们承认这点。我们本该更早察觉到你的存在。统御者，您本不该创造出……

entries.source: Lia... Aliana?  I should have known.  Your name, how you never talked about Aliana, what you knew about me...
entries.translation: 莉娅……阿利亚娜？我早该明白的。你的名字，你从不谈论阿利亚娜，你对我的一切了如指掌……

entries.source: We see what we want to see, Father.  It took me many years to discover my true form.  You still have a choice, you can still choose to be Skarsgard Abraxis.  Remember his life and what he stood for.
entries.translation: 我们往往只看得到自己想看到的事物，父亲。我花了许多年才发现自己的真正形态。您仍有选择，您依然可以选择成为斯卡斯加德·阿布拉克西斯。回想他的一生，回想他所坚守的一切吧。

entries.source: Nonsense!  Imperator, all that has transpired has done so according to your plan!  We have revealed the Arc Eternal for you!  Now, join with us as you have foretold!
entries.translation: 荒谬！统御者，发生的一切皆是按照您的计划进行的！我们已为您揭示了永恒弧！现在，遵照您的预言，与我们融合吧！

entries.source: Father, remember the life of Skarsgard Abraxis.  Remember him...
entries.translation: 父亲，记住斯卡斯加德·阿布拉克西斯的一生。记住他……

entries.source: Father!  Something just dropped out of Warp in this system.  It's badly damaged and heading for this planet!
entries.translation: 父亲！有东西刚刚脱离曲速进入了这个星系。它受损严重，正朝这颗星球冲来！

entries.source: I see it... it's a ship.  Platius... you old fool!  Aliana, Platius must have set this mighty ship on course for this planet!
entries.translation: 我看到了……是一艘飞船。普拉提乌斯……你这个老傻瓜！阿利亚娜，一定是普拉提乌斯设定了这艘巨舰冲向这颗星球的航线！

entries.source: I will attempt to predict the crash site on the map... clear out anything in the way!
entries.translation: 我将尝试在地图上预测坠毁地点……清除路径上的一切阻碍！

entries.source: Loki Hive, I remember all now.  Skarsgard Abraxis is a modicum of my full being, but one that has shown me a great understanding.
entries.translation: 洛基蜂群，我现在全都记起来了。斯卡斯加德·阿布拉克西斯只是我完整存在的一部分，但他却让我领悟了极深邃的真理。

entries.source: I choose this form.  I will not join with you, nor will I allow you to control the Arc.
entries.translation: 我选择这个形态。我不会与你们融合，也绝不允许你们掌控永恒弧。

entries.source: So be it, 'Skarsgard Abraxis'.  You have nothing that can harm our great Nexus.  Stay, leave... it matters not to us.
entries.translation: 随你便吧，“斯卡斯加德·阿布拉克西斯”。你没有任何手段能伤及我们伟大的枢纽。留下还是离开……对我们而言都无所谓。

entries.source: So long as we are here, you cannot control the Arc and use it for your purposes.
entries.translation: 只要我们还在这里，你就休想掌控永恒弧并将其据为己用。

entries.source: We have waited billions of years, we can wait billions more.  Can you, 'Skarsgard Abraxis'?  Can you? [Loki Hive Transmission Terminated]
entries.translation: 我们已经等待了数十亿年，还能再等上数十亿年。你能吗，“斯卡斯加德·阿布拉克西斯”？你能吗？[洛基蜂群通讯终止]

entries.source: Thank you father.... thank you for choosing the right path.
entries.translation: 谢谢你，父亲……谢谢你选择了正确的道路。

entries.source: Aliana, is there nothing we can do?
entries.translation: 阿利亚娜，我们真的无能为力了吗？

entries.source: I don't see anything possible, father.  That Nexus has a shield that no weapons can penetrate.  Even if we could, the Nexus itself seems indestructible.
entries.translation: 我看不到任何希望，父亲。那个枢纽拥有任何武器都无法穿透的护盾。就算能穿透，枢纽本身似乎也坚不可摧。

entries.source: We will fight on anyway, daughter.  If we must fight for a million years, we will do so.  But we must never leave.
entries.translation: 无论如何我们都要战斗下去，女儿。如果必须战斗一百万年，我们也会奉陪到底。但我们绝不能离开。

entries.source: As foretold, my children, I return to you at our greatest moment.  You have done well and pleased me.
entries.translation: 正如预言所说，我的孩子们，我在我们最伟大的时刻回到了你们身边。你们做得很好，让我很欣慰。

entries.source: Welcome, our Imperator.  We stand at your command.
entries.translation: 恭迎我们的统御者。我们听候您的差遣。

entries.source: I now join with you in the Nexus and will cleanse this world.
entries.translation: 我现在与你们一同进入枢纽，净化这个世界。

entries.source: You too may join us Aliana.  You are of our kind, join with us and we will rule over all time as we see fit.
entries.translation: 阿利亚娜，你也可以加入我们。你与我们同属一类，加入我们，我们将随心所欲地统治整个时间。

entries.source: No, father.  I remember the life of Skarsgard Abraxis and won't choose to forget.
entries.translation: 不，父亲。我记得作为斯卡斯加德·阿布拉克西斯的那一生，我绝不会选择遗忘。

entries.source: 'Skarsgard Abraxis' is a part of my existence, much as a grain of sand is a part of a world.  It is something insignificant compared to the whole!  Join, Aliana.
entries.translation: “斯卡斯加德·阿布拉克西斯”不过是我存在的一部分，就像一粒沙之于一个世界。与整体相比，它是微不足道的！加入我们吧，阿利亚娜。

entries.source: Fath... Imperator, you leave me no choice.  I must destroy your Nexus.  You cannot be allowed to control the Arc.
entries.translation: 父……统御者，你让我别无选择。我必须摧毁你的枢纽。绝不能让你控制永恒弧。

entries.source: So be it, Aliana.  After your destruction I shall remake you in a more compliant form.  Some form of you will join with us, of this you can rest assured.
entries.translation: 既然如此，阿利亚娜。将你毁灭之后，我会以更顺从的形态将你重塑。某种形式的你终将加入我们，这一点你大可放心。

entries.source: Lia, we failed!  The Prism Ship has been completed and is launching. Nothing can stop it now...
entries.translation: 莉娅，我们失败了！棱镜战舰已经完工并且正在发射。现在谁也阻止不了它了……

entries.source: Hold on a sec, Skars...  There may yet be a sliver of hope.
entries.translation: 等一下，斯卡斯……可能还有一线希望。

entries.source: The Enhanced Totem in the north east, I think I can now set our nullifiers to destroy it.
entries.translation: 东北方向的那个强化图腾，我想我现在可以设定消除器来摧毁它了。

entries.source: The Enhanced Totem is opening its outer guard doors and I am able to scan its modulation frequency.  It operates just like a normal Totem in this regard.  If...
entries.translation: 强化图腾正在打开外层防护舱门，我可以扫描它的调制频率了。在这方面它的运作方式和普通图腾一模一样。如果……

entries.source: ...If you set the Nullifiers to the same rift space modulation frequency, they will direct the blast energy into the heart of the Enhanced Totem and destroy it.
entries.translation: ……如果你把消除器设定为相同的裂隙空间调制频率，它们就会把冲击能量直接导入强化图腾的核心并摧毁它。

entries.source: Exactly.  Only problem is we have to do it before the Prism Ship docks above the Enhanced Totem and completes its firing sequence.  Once that happens, everything in this system will be destroyed.
entries.translation: 没错。唯一的问题是，我们必须在棱镜飞船停靠在强化图腾上方并完成发射程序之前做到这一点。一旦完成，这个星系中的一切都将被毁灭。

entries.source: Alright, Lia.  It isn't often we get a second chance, so I'll throw everything we have at that Enhanced Totem!
entries.translation: 明白了，莉娅。能够重来一次的机会可不多，所以我要倾尽全力砸向那个强化图腾！

entries.source: The Prism Ship has started its firing sequence....  You have 20 minutes to nullify it, or everything in this system will be destroyed.  That includes us, Skars.
entries.translation: 棱镜飞船已经启动了发射程序……你有 20 分钟的时间来清除它，否则这个星系中的一切都会被毁灭。也包括我们，斯卡斯。

entries.source: I've been almost dead plenty of times, Lia.  Relax and watch....
entries.translation: 我死里逃生过不知道多少次了，莉娅。放轻松，看好了……

entries.source: That was a close call, Lia.  Too close... but we made it!
entries.translation: 真是好险，莉娅。千钧一发……但我们成功了！

entries.source: I have some other good news.  I have analyzed the wreckage of the ship and I can determine where it was designed to transmit information to.
entries.translation: 我还有些别的好消息。我已经分析了飞船的残骸，可以查明它原计划向何处传输信息。

entries.source: You said it would send information into the remnants of Rift Space...
entries.translation: 你刚才说它会把信息发送到裂隙空间的残余区域中……

entries.source: Yes, and the compressed information beam would then exit into normal space.  The exit point is only one star system away from here.
entries.translation: 是的，随后压缩信息束会穿出并进入常规空间。出口位置距离这里仅仅隔着一个星系。

entries.source: Ha.... ha ha ha ha...  Platius, only your cunningness exceeds your age.  What are the odds, Lia?  What are the odds we would be here at just the right place?
entries.translation: 哈……哈哈哈哈……普拉提乌斯，唯有你的狡黠能胜过你的年岁。这概率有多大啊，莉娅？我们正好来到这恰到好处的地方，几率能有多大？

entries.source: It seems highly improbable.  Either we were brought here or the Loki came here.  In either case, our destiny awaits.
entries.translation: 这看起来极不可能。要么是我们被引导到了这里，要么就是洛基来到了此处。无论如何，我们的宿命都在前方等待着。

entries.source: Prepare to warp, Lia.  Prepare to warp...
entries.translation: 准备跃迁，莉娅。准备跃迁……

entries.source: Sample the sound with 'Play'.  Use the string name in scripts.

entries.source:
The trains travel on a system of terrain level 8 rails.
The switches work by raising or lowering portions of track.
Press the escape key now to skip the tutorial.
entries.context: alpha_troublesome trains 01 - tutorial / Train_Scores.crpl / ShowMessage output 3
entries.translation:
列车沿着高度为 8 的轨道行驶。
通过升降部分轨道来切换道岔。
现在按 Escape 键可跳过教程。

entries.context: alpha_troublesome trains 01 - tutorial / Train_Scores.crpl / ShowMessage output 4

entries.source:
Unfortunately, your trains won't always arrive at the correct places.
There are several ways in which this may happen, which I will explain.
First, your trains may derail if the switches are improperly managed.
entries.context: alpha_troublesome trains 01 - tutorial / Train_Scores.crpl / ShowMessage output 5
entries.translation:
可惜，列车并不总能抵达正确的目的地。
接下来我会说明可能发生的几种意外。
首先，道岔操作不当可能导致列车脱轨。

entries.context: alpha_troublesome trains 01 - tutorial / Train_Scores.crpl / ShowMessage output 6

entries.source:
As you can see, a derailment does more than cost you 5 points. It
also disrupts the area, and destroys more tracks. These damaged tracks
may cause chain reactions of derailments, so you should fix them like this.
entries.context: alpha_troublesome trains 01 - tutorial / Train_Scores.crpl / ShowMessage output 7
entries.translation:
如你所见，脱轨不仅会让你损失 5 分，
还会破坏周围区域和更多轨道。这些损坏的轨道
可能引发接连脱轨，因此你应当像这样修复它们。

entries.source:
Another way that you can lose points is by sending trains
to the wrong stations. If a train arrives at the wrong station,
you will lose 2 points.
entries.context: alpha_troublesome trains 01 - tutorial / Train_Scores.crpl / ShowMessage output 8
entries.translation:
把列车送到错误的车站也会扣分。
如果列车抵达错误的车站，
你会被扣除 2 分。

entries.source:
The trains that come from the station have random targets. After one
train is sent, the system will wait a short time before preparing
the next one to be sent to a random destination on the map.
entries.context: alpha_troublesome trains 01 - tutorial / Train_Scores.crpl / ShowMessage output 9
entries.translation:
车站发出的列车会随机选择目的地。一班列车
发出后，系统会稍等片刻，再准备下一班列车，
并为它随机选择地图上的目的地。
